blogPosts.title: ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ: 'ਨੱਕ ਦੀ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀ ਉਮੀਦ ਕਰਨੀ ਹੈ
blogPosts.excerpt: ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ( ਨੱਕ ਦੀ ਸਰਜਰੀ ) ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕੀ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਿਕਵਰੀ ਕਿੰਨੀ ਦੇਰ ਲੈਂਦੀ ਹੈ? ਪੂਰੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਇੱਥੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।
blogPosts.content:
ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਕੀ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ?

ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਇੱਕ ਕਿਸਮ ਦੀ ਪਲਾਸਟਿਕ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਇਹ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਮਰੀਜਾਂ ਲਈ ਲਾਹੇਵੰਦ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਨੱਕ ਦੇ ਆਕਾਰ ਜਾਂ ਸ਼ਕਲ ਤੋਂ ਖੁਸ਼ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਦਰਸਲ ਇਹ ਨੱਕ ਦੇ ਆਕਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਬਲਦੀ ਹੈ। ਕੁਝ ਲੋਕੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਚਿਹਰੇ ਦੀ ਦਿੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਬਦਲਣ ਲਈ ਇਹ ਕਾਸਮੈਟਿਕ ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਕਰਵਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਦੂਜੇ ਫੰਕਸ਼ਨਲ ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਕਰਵਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ ਜੋ ਕਿ ਸਾਹ ਲੈਣ ਅਤੇ ਨੱਕ ਦੇ ਕੰਮ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਦਾ ਕੰਮ ਚਮੜੀ ਦੀ ਕਿਸਮ ਅਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਚਿਹਰੇ ਦੇ ਢਾਂਚੇ ਨੂੰ ਧਿਆਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੱਖਦੇ ਹੋਏ, ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਦੀ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਦਿੱਖ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਰਜਸ਼ੀਲਤਾ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਉਸਦੀ ਨੱਕ ਨੂੰ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਨੂੰ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਸਰਜਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਲਾਸਟਿਕ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਜਾਂ ਚਿਹਰੇ ਦੀ ਪਲਾਸਟਿਕ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਦੀ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਨੂੰ ਆਮ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਨੱਕ  ਦੀ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 

ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਤੇਜ਼ ਤੱਥ

ਆਮ ਤੋਰ ਤੇ ਮਰੀਜਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਿਹਤ ਵਧੀਆ ਹੋਣੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਗਰਟ ਦਾ ਨਸ਼ਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਨਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਸਿਗਰਟ ਪੀਣ ਨਾਲ ਖੂਨ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਘੱਟ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਟਿਸ਼ੂਆਂ ਦੇ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਦਾ ਖ਼ਤਰਾ ਵੱਧ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 

ਇਹ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਕਿਸ਼ੋਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੀ ਸੰਭਵ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਰੀਕੇ ਨਾਲ ਮਾਪਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਰੱਖਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰੀਕੇ ਨਾਲ ਸਮਝਦੇ ਹਨ। 

ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਵਿਚ ਕੁੜੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ 15 ਜਾਂ 16 ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਹੋਣੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ,ਮੁੰਡਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ 17 ਜਾਂ 18 ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਹੋਣੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ।

ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ?

ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਤੁਸੀ ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਦੇ ਮਾਹਿਰ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲਣਾ ਚਾਓਗੇ ਅਤੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਮੁਲਾਕਾਤ ਕਰੋਗੇ, ਇਹ ਮੁਲਾਕਾਤ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਵਾਰੇ ਸਵਾਲ ਪੁੱਛਣ ਅਤੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨਤੀਜਿਆਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਦੱਸਣ ਦਾ ਮੌਕਾ ਦਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ।ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ, ਸਰਜਨ ਇਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਇਸਦੇ ਜੋਖਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਫਾਇਦਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਮਝਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਨਹੀਂ। ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਇੱਕ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਹੈ, ਇਹ ਬਹੁਤ ਹੀ ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਨੱਕ ਦੀ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਇੱਕ ਮਾਹਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਹੋਵੇ। ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੱਸ ਦਈਏ ਕਿ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ 3D ਇਮੇਜਿੰਗ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਮਰੀਜ ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਦਿਖਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਕਿ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਨੱਕ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਦਾ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦੇਵੇਗਾ। ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਸਰਜਨ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਨੱਕ ਦੇ ਮਾਡਲਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਿੰਟ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ,ਅਤੇ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਇਹ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਉਮੀਦ ਕੀਤੀ ਦਿੱਖ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ,ਇਹ ਵਿਦਿਅਕ ਸਾਧਨ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਨਤੀਜਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਗਰੰਟੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ.ਇਹ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਦੇ ਟੀਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਢੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਸੰਚਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਅਨੁਮਾਨਿਤ ਨਤੀਜਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਕਲਪਨਾ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਨਾਲ ਮਰੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਧੇਰੇ ਆਰਾਮਦਾਇਕ ਮਹਿਸੂਸ ਕਰਵਾਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ 3D ਪ੍ਰਿੰਟ ਮਾਡਲ ਇੱਕ ਵਿਕਲਪ ਹੈ ਜੋ  ਸਰਜਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਿੱਖ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ 

ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ?

ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਵਿਚ ਆਮ ਤੋਰ ਤੇ 2 ਜਾਂ 3 ਘੰਟਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਲਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਨੂੰ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਵੀ ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸਦੇ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਮਰੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਘੱਟ ਸਮੇਂ ਲਈ ਹਲਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਾਨੀ ਵੀ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਹੜੀ ਕਿ ਆਮ ਗੱਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਮਰੀਜਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਸਮਝਣਾ ਬਹੁਤ ਜਰੂਰੀ ਹੈ, ਕਿ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਦਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪੜਾਅ ਬਰਦਾਸ਼ਤ ਕਰਨਾ ਥੋੜ੍ਹਾ ਔਖਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ,ਅਤੇ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਨੱਕ ਦੀਆਂ ਹੱਡੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਰਟੀਲੇਜ ਦੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਲਈ ਬਹੁਤ ਧਿਆਨ ਦੇਣ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। 

ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੀ ਰਿਕਵਰੀ ਸਮਾਂ ਕੀ ਹੈ?

ਸਰਜਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਇੱਕ ਮਰੀਜ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਕਈ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਭਵ ਮਹਿਸੂਸ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਜੋ ਕਿ ਮਹੀਨਿਆਂ ਤੱਕ ਜਾਰੀ ਰਹਿ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ, ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾਤਰ ਮਰੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਹਲਕੀ ਤੋਂ ਦਰਮਿਆਨੀ ਬੇਅਰਾਮੀ ਮਹਿਸੂਸ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ,ਜਿਹੜੀ ਕਿ ਦਵਾਈ ਨਾਲ ਕੰਟਰੋਲ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਠੀਕ ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਲਈ ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਨੂੰ 1 ਸਾਲ ਤੱਕ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਲੱਗ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸਰਜਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਮਰੀਜ ਦੇ ਨੱਕ ਦੇ ਆਸ-ਪਾਸ ਲਗਭਗ ਚਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਛੇ ਹਫ਼ਤਿਆਂ ਤੱਕ ਸੋਜ ਰਹੇਗੀ। ਜਿਹੜੀ ਕਿ 3 ਮਹੀਨਿਆਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਹੋਲੀ -ਹੋਲੀ ਘੱਟ ਹੋ ਜਾਵੇਗੀ, ਪਰ 3 ਮਹੀਨਿਆਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਵੀ ਇਹ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਇਹ ਇਸਦਾ ਠੀਕ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਮਰੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਦੋ ਤੋਂ ਤਿੰਨ ਹਫ਼ਤਿਆਂ ਤੱਕ ਜੌਗਿੰਗ ਤੇ ਤੈਰਾਕੀ ਵਰਗੀਆਂ ਸਖ਼ਤ ਗਤੀਵਿਧੀਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਦੂਰ ਰਹਿਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਚਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਪੰਜ ਹਫ਼ਤਿਆਂ ਲਈ ਐਨਕਾਂ ਪਹਿਨਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਨੱਕ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਰੀਕੇ ਨਾਲ ਠੀਕ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਤੁਸੀ ਇਸਦੇ ਨਤੀਜ਼ੇ ਦੇਖੋਗੇ, ਜੋ ਕਿ ਆਮ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਸਾਲ ਬਾਅਦ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੀ ਰਿਕਵਰੀ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਹਰੇਕ ਲਈ ਵੱਖਰਾ -ਵੱਖਰਾ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। 

ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਿੰਨੀ ਆਮ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ?

ਔਰਤ ਅਤੇ ਮਰਦ ਦੋਨੋ ਹੀ ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਕਰਵਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਆਮ ਤੋਰ ਤੇ ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਨੂੰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਆਮ ਕਾਸਮੈਟਿਕ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਇੱਕ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਆਮ ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਸੰਯੁਕਤ ਰਾਜ ਅਮਰੀਕਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਰ ਸਾਲ 350,000 ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਸਰਜਾਰੀਆਂ ਹੁੰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ਜਦੋਂ ਕਿ ਔਰਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਮਰਦ ਹਰ ਸਾਲ ਅਮਰੀਕਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਸਰਜਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਲਗਭਗ 20% ਤੱਕ ਹੀ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ 

ਸਿੱਟਾ: ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਵੀ ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਬਾਰੇ ਗਹਿਰਾਈ ਤੱਕ ਜਾਨਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਵੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਨੱਕ ਦੇ ਆਕਾਰ ਜਾਂ ਸ਼ਕਲ ਤੋਂ ਖੁਸ਼ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਾਨੀ ਦਾ ਹੱਲ ਕਰਨਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋ ਤਾਂ ਕਲੀਨਿਕ ਬਾਈ ਚੋਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਕੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਅਪੋਇੰਟਮੈਂਟ ਅੱਜ ਹੀ ਬੁੱਕ ਕਰਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਮੌਕਾ ਪਾਓ ਰਾਈਨੋਪਲਾਸਟੀ ਦੇ ਮਾਹਿਰਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਲਾਹ ਅਤੇ ਗੱਲ ਬਾਤ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ।

blogPosts.title: अंडकोष में दर्द क्या है इसके का कारण, लक्षण और उपचार
blogPosts.excerpt: पुरुषों में अंडकोष में दर्द कई कारणों से हो सकता है जैसे चोट, संक्रमण या सूजन। जानें घरेलू उपचार और राहत पाने के तरीके। क्लिक करें और जानें पूरी जानकारी।
blogPosts.content:
वृषण दर्द क्या है?

वृषण दर्द व्यक्ति के एक या दोनों अंडकोषों में हो वाले दर्द और असुविधा को दर्शाते हैं। अंडकोष में दर्द, वृषण दर्द या फिर ऑर्कियलजिया के रूप में भी जाना जाता है। प्रभावित व्यक्तियों के लिए ये एक ऐसी स्थिति होती है जो उनको असुविधा और चिंता पैदा कर देती है। वृषण दर्द की तीव्रता अलग अलग होती है और ये तीव्रता समय के साथ बनी रहने और अचानक से और ज्यादा गंभीर हो सकती है। अंडकोष पुरुषों का महत्वपूर्ण प्रजनन अंग होता है। दर्द के साथ वृषण में लालिमा, गर्मी, बुखार, सूजन या वृषण के आकार में बदलाव जैसे और भी लक्षण हो सकते हैं। इस दर्द को आप एक या दोनों अंडकोष में महसूस कर सकते हैं। जब ये दर्द आपको होता है तो ऐसा नहीं है की ये आपके अंडकोष में से ही आ रहा हो, ये दर्द आपके शरीर के किसी और दूसरे भाग जैसे की कमर और पेट से भी ये आ सकता है इसको संदर्भित दर्द के नाम से जाना जाता है। हालांकि अगर अंडकोष में दर्द लगातार या एक घंटे से ज्यादा समय तक रहता है तो आपको  इसका ध्यान रखना बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है अगर ऐसा होता है तो आप वृषण दर्द के उचित निदान और इलाज़ के लिए इसके विशेष्ज्ञो के पास जाएं और अपना इलाज करवाएं। 

अंडकोष में दर्द के कारण

1. वृषण मरोड़

वृषण मरोड़ एक मेडिकल इमरजेंसी है यह तब होती है जब शुक्राणु कॉर्ड मुड़ जाता है, जिसमें रक्त की आपूर्ति बंद हो जाती है। ऐसी गंभीर स्थिति में असहनीय दर्द भी हो सकता है और वृषण के नुकसान को रोकने के लिए तुरंत डॉक्टरी इलाज की आवश्यकता होती है।

2. गुर्दे की पथरी :

गुर्दे की पथरी एक पत्थर की तरह होती है, जो की कठोर खनिज जमा होती है। जब पथरी मूत्र पथ से नीचे चली जाती है और मूत्रवाहिनी में फंस जाती है तो वे कमर और वृषण क्षेत्र में दर्द का कारण बनती है जिससे कि अंडकोष में असहनीय दर्द हो सकता है। 

3. वंक्षण हर्निया

वंक्षण हर्निया तब होता है जब आंत या पेट के ऊतकों का एक हिस्सा वंक्षण नलिका  से बाहर निकल जाता है। ये अंडकोष में दर्द का कारण बनता है। ये दर्द खास करके उन गतिविधियों के दौरान होता है जो पेट के अंदर के दबाव को बढ़ाती हैं, जैसे की तनाव लेना और भारी सामान को उठाना। 

4. वृषण आघात 

वृषण में दर्द और सूजन के कारण हो सकते हैं जैसे कि अंडकोष में चोट का लगना, सीधा चोट लगना और कोई दुर्घटना का शिकार हो जाना। 

5. वैरीकोसेल

अंडकोष के अंदर वैरिकाज़ नसों के समान बढ़ी हुई नसें होती हैं। इससे अंडकोष में खिंचाव और असुविधा भी हो महसूस हो सकती है। 

6. हाइड्रोसील

ये एक तरीके के तरल पदार्थ से भरी हुई एक थैली होती है, और ये अंडकोष के चारों तरफ बन जाती है जो कि अंडकोष के दर्द और सूजन का कारण बनती है। 

अंडकोष में दर्द के लक्षण

  • दोनों या एक ही में तेज या हल्के दर्द का महसूस होना। 
  • अंडकोष में सूजन या वृद्धि होना। 
  • अंडकोष में लालिमा और सूजन होना 
  • (संक्रमण के मामले में )ठंड या बुखार होना 
  • गंभीर मामलों में मतली या उल्टी होना 
  • पेशाब में खून (हेमाट्यूरिया)
  • बार बार पेशाब का आना या फिर पेशाब करते वक्त परेशानी होना 
  • एक गांठ का अंडकोष में या द्रव्यमान

अंडकोष में दर्द से राहत के लिए घरेलू उपचार

1.आराम और ऊंचाई : 

अंडकोष को आराम देने और सहायक तकिये के साथ ऊपर उठाने से सूजन और असुविधा को कम किया जा सकता है।  

2.बर्फ की पट्टियाँ लगाना :

ऐसे मामलों में ज्यादातर अंडकोष पर ठंडी पट्टियां या फिर बर्फ की पत्तियों को लगाने से अंडकोष की सूजन और दर्द को सुन्न करने और कम करने में मदद मिलती है। खास तौर पर तीव्र आघात या सूजन के मामलों में राहत मिलती है। 

3.सहायक अंडरवियर : 

सहायक, सपोर्टिव और आरामदायक या फिर अंडकोषीय सपोर्ट पहनने से बड़ा आराम मिल सकता है और हल्का दबाव भी मिल सकता है। इससे होने वाली असुविधा कम हो सकती है और खास तोर पर शारीरिक गतिविधि के दौरान।

4.स्वच्छता : 

जननांगों की अच्छे तरीके से सफाई रखें और किसी भी तरीके से संक्रमण होने से बचाएं ये उपचार को बढ़ावा देने में मदद कर सकता है।

5.दर्द प्रबंधन :

दर्द को कंट्रोल करने के लिए ओवर-द-काउंटर दर्द निवारक दवाओं का इस्तेमाल करें जैसे की इबुप्रोफेन या एसिटामिनोफेन जैसी नॉनस्टेरॉइडल एंटी-इंफ्लेमेटरी दवाएं (एनएसएआईडी) ये दवाएं अंडकोष की सूजन को कम करती हैं और दर्द से राहत देते हैं।  इन दवाइयों का इस्तेमाल करने से पहले अपने डॉक्टर से सलाह करें और उसकी  सिफारिशों का पालन करें। 

6.हाइड्रेट रहना : 

अगर हम अपने शरीर को हाइड्रेट रखते हैं तो हम कोई भी संक्रमण पैदा करने वाले बैक्टीरिया को हम अपने शरीर से बाहर निकल सकते हैं किसी भी बीमारी से बच सकते हैं और इससे वृषण स्वास्थ्य को बढ़ावा मिल सकता है।

7. ट्रिगर करने वाले कारकों से बचना

वह ट्रिगर जो आपके दर्द की समस्या को बढ़ाते या फिर पैदा करते हैं,  कोई भी गतिविधि जैसे कि साइकिल को चलाना या फिर लंबे समय तक बैठे रहना आदि दर्द के कम होने तक इन चीजों से ज्यादातर बचना चाहिए। 

निष्कर्ष :

व्यक्ति के अंडकोष में होने वाला दर्द असहनीय होता है ये अचानक से गंभीर और काफी वक्त तक रह सकता है। इसके लक्ष्णों कि पहचान करके इसको तुरंत डॉक्टर को दिखाना चाहिए और कुछ घरेलू उपचारों से भी इसको ठीक और दर्द को राहत मिल सकती है अगर आप भी ऐसी ही किसी गंभीर समस्या के शिकार हैं इस समस्या के बारेमें जानना चाहते हैं तो आप आज ही क्लिनिक बाय चॉइस में जाकर अपनी अपॉइंटमेंट को बुक करें और आप इसके विशषज्ञों से बात कर सकते हो और अपना इलाज़ करवा सकते हो।

blogPosts.title: IVF And ICSI: The Treatments Taking You Closer To The Parenthood Phase
blogPosts.excerpt: Explore how IVF and ICSI treatments help couples overcome infertility challenges and take confident steps toward parenthood.
blogPosts.content:
There is no doubt about the fact that facing fertility issues or going through recurrent miscarriages can be an emotionally and physically overwhelming situation. It takes courage and the right fertility treatment options to reclaim parenthood. However, while exploring fertility treatments, it can be all confusing between IVF and ICSI. Understanding these fertility treatments can help you make informed decisions and select the best IVF centre in Punjab. 

Also, both these treatments come under ART which is assisted reproductive technology, and are best suited for people who are facing infertility problems or recurrent miscarriages. However, the fertilization approach, success rate, and other factors of these treatments are different. Thus, there is a need to understand these treatments and their suitability on a broader level. 

The basics of IVF and ICSI 

Before getting into the differences between IVF and ICSI treatment, it is imperative to understand the workings of these treatments. They come under ART or assisted reproductive technology. However, the fertilization approach of these treatments is different. So, let’s explore these basics. 

Understanding In Vitro Fertilisation 

If one has to know a well-established fertility treatment then it has to be IVF. In this fertility treatment, the eggs and sperm are collected to get them fertilized in a selected lab. Later, after the completion of the fertilization process, the transfer is done to the uterus. This is an effective method in experiencing pregnancy.. 

The working of the IVF procedure 

To know IVF better, it is essential to know its working method: 

  • Under this process, ovarian stimulation is done. This is executed to produce multiple eggs. 
  • Later the egg retrieval step is done. Also, sperm are collected to proceed with another step. 
  • In a laboratory, the process of natural fertilization is executed. This is done in a dish with complete precision. 
  • The last step involves transferring the embryo back to the uterus. 

Who should opt for In Vitro Fertilisation treatment? 

For people feeling skeptical or confused about this treatment, it is considered best for:

  • When there are blocked or damaged fallopian tubes.
  • If there is a situation related to endometriosis-related infertility. 
  • If the couple is facing unexplained infertility issues. 
  • IVF should also be opted when infertility issues occur due to males. 

Understanding ICSI or Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection Treatment 

There is also an advanced form of IVF. Indulging in ICSI can allow in having fruitful results. It is designed in such a way that the process helps in overcoming male infertility challenges. In place of sperm fertilizing the egg in the most natural way, this process involves the injection of a single sperm into the egg with the involvement of a needle.

The working of ICSI treatment 

To understand better, it is essential to understand the working of the ICSI treatment: 

  • The process is initiated with egg retrieval as well as a collection of sperm. 
  • The next step is to select a healthy sperm out of all. 
  • The healthy sperm are injected. This is done in direct connection with egg. 
  • The last step involved in this treatment is embryo transfer which is done to the uterus. 

Who should consider ICSI treatment? 

This advanced form of IVF treatment is considered best for: 

  • The people who are facing low sperm count. Also, people who have low sperm motility can opt for ICSI treatment. 
  • If there are any abnormal sperm morphologies.  
  • This treatment can also be opted for when you have faced IVF failures previously. 
  • ICSI can also be opted for with frozen or surgically retrieved sperm. 

ICSI and IVF treatments: When are they recommended? 

Not every fertility treatment is meant for everyone. It is essential to keep in mind certain factors play a huge role in the recommendation of IVF and ICSI treatments. For instance, previous history, sperm quality, any underlying issues, and much more play a vital role in proceeding with the treatment. 

The recommendation of IVF procedure:

  • When a woman is facing blocked and sometimes even damaged fallopian tubes. 
  • When couples are not aware of their infertility situation or are facing unexplained infertility. 
  • IVF is also suitable when male factor infertility is mildly present. 

The recommendation of ICSI treatment: 

  • When male infertility is being faced and no other treatment is working, then ICSI can be opted. Plus, there are issues like low sperm count, abnormal morphology, and much more. 
  • Also, when there is a situation of a failed IVF procedure. 
  • ICSI treatment is recommended when the use of frozen sperm or surgically retrieved sperm is involved. 

What factors to keep in mind when choosing either of the fertility treatments? 

No wonder medical recommendations should be given the utmost importance. But there are many other factors that should not be neglected, such as: 

  • Success rate and the treatment’s effectiveness 

It is essential to keep in mind the success rate of these treatments as well as their effectiveness: 

  • IVF and ICSI treatments have good success rates when they are used in a proper way. 
  • If a person is facing male infertility at a severe level then choosing ICSI treatment can be the best option. 
  • IVF is considered in most cases. However, if there are no issues with the quality of sperm, then IVF is the best solution.  
  • Considering the overall costs 

Considering IVF cost in Punjab and costs of ICSI should be given priority:

  • ICSI is considered slightly costly as compared to IVF as there is involvement of additional lab techniques. 
  • IVF treatment can turn out to be cost-effective when there are no issues with the sperm. 
  • Any previous history 

Previous medical history can be neglected at any cost. If there is a previous situation of failed IVF procedure, then choosing ICSI is considered best for favorable fertilization outcomes.

  • Emotional and financial readiness 

A person or couple needs to commit to the emotional and financial demands of these treatments. However, having an in-depth consultation with an expert can turn out to be beneficial. 

Conclusion 

Depending on the fertility condition of an individual, IVF or ICSI treatments can be opted for. The IVF process somehow mimics the actual fertilization process which is a simple solution. However, ICSI treatment is best opted for during serious male infertility issues. Also, both treatments have high success rates and can allow you to reclaim parenthood at the earliest. Consulting the best and most experienced doctor can allow you to go through personalized care and the best fertility solutions.

blogPosts.title: 5 Essential Ways to Promote a Healthy Digestive System
blogPosts.excerpt: Support your gut health with these 5 proven ways, from eating fiber-rich foods to staying hydrated and managing stress effectively.
blogPosts.content:
Having a healthy digestive system is perhaps one of the most important things you need to accomplish in your life. A healthy stomach makes us completely and thoroughly functional without any worries. One needs to actively make certain that they are capable of taking care of their digestive system. If you live on your own, it can be difficult to priortise your health in a thorough manner. With the help of experts at Ameritus Hospital, you can not only figure out ways in which you can take care of your digestive system in a thorough manner, but also receive an official diagnosis and treatment plan when things are indeed wrong with your digestive system.

Balanced Diet

blogPosts.title: Steps For Root Canal Treatment
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn the key steps of root canal treatment, from diagnosis to recovery. Discover how this procedure saves teeth, relieves pain, and restores oral health.
blogPosts.content:
Oral treatments are very important as they help to maintain overall health and wellbeing. The most common culprit in dentistry is cavities. These cavities cause a lot of health issues like headaches and jaw pain, and they have also been linked to heart problems as the bacteria in the cavities can enter the bloodstream, ultimately affecting the heart. Clothes may develop bad breath due to cavities, which also affects social interactions and can dwindle one's self-esteem. That is why it is important to go for root canal treatment in Ludhiana as soon as cavities are detected to avoid any health complications. 

What Is A Root Canal?  

This is a procedure in dentistry that aims to restore oral health by treating infected or damaged endodontium. The infected soft tissue of the tooth is treated by extracting it from the tooth, cleaning it, and then disinfecting the tooth. This approach helps to alleviate pain, prevent tooth loss, and restore the functionality of the tooth. Root canal treatment is generally not that painful, thanks to the advancement of technology, as modern methods and local anesthesia are administered, resulting in a painless procedure. Moreover, root canal treatment costs in Ludhiana may vary depending on several factors. Therefore, it's advisable to consult a dentist.

Steps For Root Canal Treatment

This approach consists of several steps that include the following:

Examination and X-ray - This is usually the first step for root canal treatment in Ludhiana, where the dentist closely inspects the tooth to evaluate the magnitude of the damage. The endodontist will proceed to take X-rays to observe the root canals. 

Local anesthesia - This part is very mandatory. The medicine is induced to ensure a comfortable and painless procedure. It causes loss of sensation in the tooth and surrounding areas.

Isolation -.The isolation process helps to ensure that the tooth stays dry during the procedure. The dentist will place a dental dam, which acts as a blockade for saliva and other fluids.

Access opening - A small opening is made into the tooth crown so that the dentist can have access to the endodontium chamber and root canal.

Pulp removal - The infected endodontium is carefully extracted from the endodontium chamber and root canal using special tools. 

Cleaning and shaping - This step is essential to eliminate any remaining debris and prepare the tooth for filling; the root canals are cleaned and shaped.

Irrigation -This is a very crucial step as it helps to disinfect the tooth. In this step,  an antimicrobial solution is utilized to rinse the canals.  

Filling -  This step is crucial to prevent reinfection. The cleaned and shaped canals are filled with a biocompatible material. 

Sealing - Typically, an endodontist uses a temporary seal to close the opening until a permanent restoration takes place

Restoration - In this last step, the dentist restores the tooth's functionality and  appearance by filling the tooth or placing a crown 

Conclusion

To achieve a successful root canal treatment, the above mentioned have to be properly followed by a dentist. Not only that, the patient has to cooperate by following instructions for the best outcome. A root canal is important as it helps to preserve one's oral health and wellbeing. blogPosts.title: Understand Everything to Know About OCD
blogPosts.excerpt: Know everything you need to know about Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD) — its symptoms, causes, diagnosis, and how to manage daily life with OCD.\"
blogPosts.content:
Living with any type of mental health issue can be a thoroughly disconcerting experience. One needs to make sure that they actually are suffering from the same. For this confirmation, you have to make an appointment with a psychiatrist in India. This will ensure that you have an official diagnosis. With an official diagnosis, you can be sure to receive the proper treatment.

Most human beings do not take their mental health seriously. They either belittle their own diagnosis or do not even go for one to begin with. However, one should not do this at all. If you have depression, seek treatment for the same. If you have OCD, explore the OCD treatment in India thoroughly before deciding on a single care provider.

In this article, we will extensively attempt to discuss and make our readers understand the concept of OCD, or Obsessive Compulsive Disorder – what it is, what are the symptoms and causes of the same, and how you can thoroughly manage the treatment for OCD so it does not disrupt your everyday life in an essential manner.

Getting diagnosed with OCD can provide to add a lot of clarity to a person’s life. If a loved one has been diagnosed with OCD, in order to support them, you can thoroughly and actively make sure to understand the disease in a thorough manner. This will help you in ensuring that your loved ones feel supported.

What is OCD?

OCD, or Obsessive Compulsive Disorder, can be thoroughly defined as a mental health disorder. In this disorder, a person has repeated intrusive thoughts or urges that the person suffering cannot let go of in a thorough manner. Until and unless they act upon the idea or the action, the urge to do it is not satiated. This then leads to repetitive behavioural patterns as a way to relieve the anxiety caused by the said obsessions.

Symptoms of OCD

When an act is repeated enough times with a sense of anxiety, it is one of the significant ways OCD is diagnosed. Common obsession patterns include the following:

  • Fear of contamination.
  • Fear of dirt.
  • Fear of something wrong happening.
  • Fear of making mistakes.
  • An obsessive need to have everything organised.
  • An obsessive need to find and follow patterns.
  • An obsessive need for orderliness and cleanliness.
  • Unwanted thoughts regarding one’s religion, sexuality, and anger.
  • Unwanted thoughts regarding hurting oneself or anyone else.
  • Unwanted thoughts regarding cursing or engaging in inappropriate behaviour.

There are also common compulsions through which one can be identified as a patient of OCD; some of these common compulsions are as follows:

  • Cleaning excessively.
  • Repeatedly checking whether the stove is on or off.
  • Repeatedly checking whether the doors and windows are locked.
  • Washing obsessively.
  • Repeating acts.
  • Obsessively repeating words or prayers.
  • Repetition of some fixed phrases.
  • Thoroughly following mental rituals.
  • Keeping things in order.
  • Arranging things in a neat and clean manner.

If you or someone you know has been exhibiting these symptoms, there is a chance that you might be struggling with OCD effectively. It is recommended that one is able to thoroughly seek the help of an expert in an essential manner. This will allow you to be sure that you are suffering from this mental health disorder. Having an official diagnosis will also ensure that you are able to find and explore the different ways to manage OCD and live your life as normally as possible.

What are the Causes of OCD?

When you are diagnosed with OCD, one of the most important questions a person has is simply: why? Why does OCD take place? What are the reasons behind it? Following are some of the reasons that can be attributed to the reason why a person can be diagnosed with OCD:

  • Genetic issues can thoroughly lead to the development of OCD.
  • Some brain changes are also associated with the development of OCD.
  • If you have PANDAS syndrome, it can also lead to the development of OCD in a thorough manner in a person.
  • If you have had any type of childhood trauma, it can also thoroughly lead to the development of OCD in a person.
  • More often than not, OCD does not occur alone. Therefore, if you have an anxiety disorder, eating disorder, or substance use disorder, you are far more likely to develop OCD in a thorough manner.

How to Manage Your OCD?

It is imperative to make sure that one is able to find tools and techniques to ensure that they are capable of managing their OCD in a thorough and essential manner. This will make sure that one is able to live a relatively everyday life without any further complications.

  • Behavioural Therapy: With behavioural therapy, you can make certain that you are able to understand what antics ticks your OCD.
  • Exposure Therapy: With exposure therapy, you can make sure that you are able to expose your OCD and attempt to control it thoroughly.
  • Response Prevention: With response prevention, you can make sure to control your urges in a thorough manner.
  • Acceptance and Commitment Therapy: With this type of therapy, you can make certain that you are able to accept that you have OCD and manage your life around it.
  • Medication: OCD can also be managed by medicines in a thorough manner. One needs to make sure that they are able to seek a psychiatrist in India to prescribe themselves medications.
  • Support Groups: With mental health disorders, you can feel isolated thoroughly. However, with support groups, you can find people with similar, if not the same, mental health disorders.
  • Stress Management: Stress management is also thoroughly essential to ensure that you are able to manage your OCD.

If you adopt the aforementioned tips and techniques into your routine in a thorough manner, you can easily make sure that you are able to manage your OCD effectively.

Conclusion

OCD is one of those mental health disorders that can disrupt the entirety of your life if left untreated. Typically, it refers to our brain’s anxious thought patterns, which lead one to obsessively perform a single task or have a single line of thought over and over again. One is, for lack of a better word, obsessed with a specific topic or thought pattern. This can be a thoroughly debilitating disorder to have, as most people who have OCD live a life thoroughly disrupted by this disorder.

blogPosts.title: Kidney Stones: What Dietary Tips Should Be Followed?
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn which dietary changes can help prevent and manage kidney stones. Discover expert tips on what to eat and avoid to support kidney health.
blogPosts.content:
There is no greater pain than kidney stones, which can even hinder daily life if not addressed at the right time. The tiny as well as hard deposits can appear anywhere in the urinary system, like the ureters, urethra, kidneys, and much more. When there is an overloading of various minerals in the urine, such as struvite, uric acid, etc., then they can get crystallized and clumped, leading to stone formation. 

Getting in touch with the best urologist in Ludhiana to fight back against kidney stones is essential. The common signs that define the need for a kidney stone doctor are bloody urine, nausea, etc. A urologist will suggest making some mandatory dietary changes to see visible results. Otherwise, kidney stone surgery remains an option. This article will help you understand the needed changes to be made in your diet so that further kidney stone prevention can be done.

Understand the kidney stone types. 

There are various types of kidney stones which can be experienced by an individual due to various factors such as: 

  • Calcium oxalate: This is a common type of kidney stone that occurs due to a certain reason. When there is a combination of calcium with different waste products, such as oxalate, it can result in stone formation. 
  • Struvite stones: This is not a very common type of kidney stone, as they are infection-related. It involves magnesium as well as ammonia, which results in the formation of struvite stones. 
  • Cystine stones: It is a rare kidney stone that occurs due to genetic disorders such as cystinuria. This happens when a certain family member already has it.
  • Uric acid stone: Uric acid stones occur from monosodium urate crystals, which are often related to obesity as well as other dietary issues. 

General dietary guidelines for people to prevent kidney stones 

Maintaining your diet to avoid having kidney stones or further worsening the situation is mandatory. Most people don't ponder upon their diet and end up with excruciating kidney stone pain. Thus, here are some general dietary tips to follow for kidney stones: 

  • Consume more fluids: When urine gets concentrated, the waste products start crystallizing. This is why it is essential to consume more fluids. Dehydration can lead to various problems, and most people are not aware of their dehydrated state. It is essential to drink around 2.5 liters of liquid each day, which is around 10 cups. Water is the best option to stay hydrated, but other options like coffee or alcohol can also be counted. However, the involvement of sugary drinks like cola, etc., can give rise to kidney stones. 
  • Consume calcium-rich food items: If a person is facing calcium oxalate stones, then it is assumed that dairy products should be given up on. But medically, calcium is required by the body to have strong bones as well as muscles. Thus, instead of having calcium supplements, it is better to complete your calcium needs via the right food items.
  • Minimise your meat consumption: Not many people know, but having kidney stones and following the idea of reducing meat consumption is a great idea. Animal protein can result in high acid levels in the urine. The crystallization process can occur, or the compounds can appear in the urine. The final result is the formation of kidney stones. Thus, limiting the intake of red meat, pork, fish, as well as chicken becomes mandatory. 
  • Add lemon or lime juice to your regimen: Having lemon or lime juice leads to kryptonite for various kidney stones. The citrate present in it can be highly helpful. It is effective in neutralising the acid which is mostly seen in urine. Thus, the formation of kidney stones can be halted. This is why it is essential to add lime or lemon to your regimen whenever it is possible during the day. The high dose of citrate can help in dissolving uric acid stones. 
  • Consult a doctor before taking any supplements: The consumption of supplements like vitamin C, calcium, as well as turmeric can lead to a high chance of getting kidney stones. But having fish oil or vitamin B6 can minimize the risk of getting them. This is the reason it is essential to have a conversation with a doctor so that the supplement consumption does not result in stone formation. 
  • Minimise your salt intake: Another reason that leads to the formation of stones is the consumption of salt. However, most people think that adding salt to their food items is the only way to increase their intake. But this is not true. There are many food items that have high amounts of sodium in them, which can worsen your situation. This is the reason it is essential to pay attention to the sodium content available in prepared food items like bread, cereal, snacks, pasta sauces, salad dressing, and much more. This way you can prevent having a kidney stone or minimize its negative effects. 
  • Rethink your food choices: Depending on your stone types, a doctor can suggest certain food items. Having a high content of oxalate in the urine can result in avoiding food items like rhubarb or spinach, and similarly, in other situations. Thus, rethinking your food choices can make a huge difference. 

Conclusion 

Diet changes can make a big difference in kidney stone treatment in Punjab. This is an initiative to prevent the formation of kidney stones. Making dietary adjustments can help in getting rid of kidney stones for good and avoid going through excruciating pain. Thus, follow the above-mentioned dietary tips, which can be effective in managing kidney stones.

blogPosts.title: The Common Causes Of A Silent Heart Attack
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn about the common causes of a silent heart attack, its risk factors, and how it often goes undetected. Understand the importance of recognising warning signs for prevention.
blogPosts.content:
It's quite alarming that heart attacks have become a significant and increasingly prevalent health issue in this modern era. Traditionally, heart attacks are known to affect older folks, but recently, young people have been reportedly experiencing heart attacks as well. This notable shift calls for awareness and precaution to ensure that both the elderly and young folks, especially, get the help that they require for improved health and overall well-being.  It is important for people to seek help by visiting any heart hospital in India for regular check-ups and consultation to avoid any heart complications, such as heart attacks.

What Is A Heart Attack

A heart attack usually occurs when a part of the heart is deprived of oxygen due to an occlusion of blood flow to that specific area. This blockage of blood flow is caused by blood clots that form on the fat that accumulates in the arteries. Lack of timely treatment of this condition causes the heart muscle cells to die and causes permanent damage. Some of the indicators of a heart attack may include back pain, dizziness, and sweating, to mention but a few. According to the best cardiologist in Ludhiana, the severity of heart attacks varies from person to person, while for others, it can be life-threatening. 

Causes Of A Silent Heart Attack 

A silent heart attack can be caused by several factors, including the following.

  • Plaque buildup and blockage - According to heart hospitals in India, plaque buildup happens over time, leading to the blockage of the blood supply to some parts of the heart. The accumulation of adipose tissue in the coronary arteries causes the coronary arteries to be constricted, leading to the restriction of blood flow to other parts of the heart. Furthermore, when the plaque is ruptured, it causes blood clots to form, which leads to the blockage of the artery, which causes a heart attack. 
  • Risk factors - Some of the risk factors that contribute to a silent heart attack include diabetes, as people with diabetes are at risk of silent heart attacks due to the nerve injury, which conceals the indicators of a heart attack. Moreover, other habits like smoking can increase the risk of getting a silent heart attack as it damages the blood vessels. Not only that,  but high cholesterol can lead to plaque formation, which causes heart attacks. According to the best cardiologist in Ludhiana, those who have a family history of heart attacks are also susceptible to heart attacks. 
  • Silent Nature -  This kind of heart attack usually occurs due to the absence of any noticeable indicators, hence they call it a silent heart attack. The absence of these signs results in delayed diagnosis and treatment, which further causes more damage to the heart. Moreover, some of the indicators may be present, like fatigue, shortness of breath, to mention but a few, but the issue is that they are not always recognised as heart attack symptoms. This is why people have to visit a cardiologist regularly to have their hearts checked in order to avoid silent heart attacks. 

Conclusion

People have to understand that prompt treatment, including medication that helps to deal with the issue of blood clots, can help to significantly reduce heart damage. People also have to take precautionary measures by consuming a healthy diet and engaging in physical activities that promote heart health to ensure the longevity of their lifespan. One can visit the nearest heart hospital for all the information pertaining to heart health, diagnosis, and treatment. Heart health should never be trivialised but rather prioritised.

blogPosts.content:
If you have been trying to get pregnant for a while, you can thoroughly prove to be an exciting prospect for many young parents. It is an exciting time in any couple’s journey towards parenthood. However, if this is your first pregnancy, it is natural to feel as though you are stepping into the unknown. One might not even know what undergoing a pregnancy to term entails properly. If there is any serious concern, it is essential to remember that you can consult the best gynecologist in Punjab anytime you have any problems.

What is the First Trimester of Pregnancy?

If you are pregnant for the first time, it can be a thoroughly difficult thing to understand what the first trimester truly is. A pregnancy typically lasts 40 weeks, which is approximately nine months. This time is divided into three parts, namely the first trimester, the second trimester, and the third trimester. Each trimester is about 13 weeks long. 

Your first trimester starts on the first day of your last menstrual period. In a normal pregnancy, the first two weeks are a part of your normal menstrual cycle. The first week is your period, while during the second week, ovulation takes place. During this second week, the fertilisation of the egg takes place. In the third week, the newly formed embryo travels down to your uterus and implants itself in your uterine lining. Now, in the fourth week of this cycle, one would get their period. However, this time you won’t because you are pregnant now. 

What are the Symptoms of the First Trimester?

There are several symptoms that can indicate that a person is pregnant; some of these symptoms of the first trimester of pregnancy are as follows: 

  • Suddenly having sore breasts.
  • Experiencing intense nausea or vomiting.
  • Suffering through mood swings.
  • Feeling extremely exhausted despite your regular routine. 
  • Feeling the need to pee again and again. 
  • Having an outbreak of acne. 
  • Suffering from a mild shortness of breath.

7 Ways You Can Manage the Symptoms of the First Trimester 

If this is your first time being pregnant, it is natural to be unaware of how you can manage your symptoms of the first trimester. In this section of the article, we thoroughly detail various ways in which you can make sure that you are able to take care of yourself in the first trimester and manage symptoms at the same time. The following are some of the ways you can do so: 

Small Yet Frequent Meals 

It is essential to make sure that you are able to thoroughly and actively eat throughout the day. Ensure that you eat food that does not upset your stomach all that much. By eating in small portions, you can make certain that you are able to replenish your body thoroughly and effectively. 

Hydration is Important 

It is also essential to ensure that you are able to stay on top of hydration in a thorough and critical manner. When one experiences bouts of nausea and vomiting, they are bound to lose water in their body. Therefore, it is essential to ensure that one keeps drinking water. 

Rest Your Body Effectively 

There will be times during the first trimester when you will feel exhausted. It is, therefore, essential to make sure that one can thoroughly and effectively rest their body in a critical manner. One does not need to push themselves through when their body is demanding rest. 

Keep Nausea and Vomiting on Check 

It might seem that your bouts of nausea or vomiting cannot be controlled. However, with ginger or peppermint, you can ease the queasiness of your stomach in a thorough and essential manner. You might also want to avoid indulging in greasy or spicy food items. 

Comfortable Clothes for Sore Breasts 

If your breasts are sore, you might want to consider investing in a comfortable bra that does not rub against your sensitive skin and leaves you aching. Indulging in a warm compress or a shower might also help. 

Light Exercise 

While it is essential to make sure that you are able to rest properly, one also needs to keep the body active. However, it is recommended that one be able to engage in a light workout in order not to harm oneself in the process. 

Manage Your Stress Effectively 

In the first trimester, it is also essential to make sure that you are able to thoroughly and actively avoid stressful situations and manage your stress effectively. With yoga and meditation, you can enhance the process of keeping your stress levels in check. 

Conclusion 

Young couples who have been trying to get pregnant are usually ecstatic to receive the news of their pregnancy. However, rarely do they know or understand what an entire pregnancy entails in a thorough manner. More often than not, they are in need of guidance. This is usually an extremely delicate matter and needs to be taken seriously. With the help of the best gynaecologist in Punjab, not only can you make sure that you are able to understand what each trimester of the pregnancy entails, but also ensure that you have professional help keeping an eye on the development of your baby in an essential manner. Ensure that you are able to carry the pregnancy to term with the help of professionals!

The ill effects of alcohol on male and female infertility 

IVF treatment or getting pregnant is not just a woman’s job. A male person needs to be equally healthy as a female person. Similarly, the consumption of alcohol can negatively impact male and female fertility. Here is how: 

  1. Female hormonal imbalances: Alcohol drinking can hamper the hormonal balance for a woman. This can further disrupt the optimal fertility levels and can interfere with oestrogen, FSH, as well as progesterone. Further, it can cause irregular menstrual cycles, ovulation issues, etc. 
  2. Poor egg quality: Alcohol intake can even hamper the egg quality of a woman. The ovaries are vulnerable, and alcohol can cause ill effects to the egg cells and their viability. Further, chromosomal abnormalities can occur. This can result in poor fertility.
  3. Low sperm quality and sperm count: Male fertility can be negatively affected by high alcohol consumption. The sperm quality as well as count can diminish with its regular consumption. Also, it can decrease the testosterone levels, hamper sperm motility, and reduce fertility in men. 
  4. Higher chances of fertility-related issues: Chronic alcohol intake can lead to polycystic ovary syndrome in women. Whereas, testicular dysfunction can be faced by men. It can cause fertility issues and various other problems. 

Alcohol intake: Risks involved before IVF treatment 

Here are some risks defined below that can occur due to alcohol intake before IVF treatment: 

  1. Low egg quality as well as ovarian reserve: Alcohol consumption can affect the hormonal imbalance, leading to a positive IVF treatment. It can hamper the production and regulation of oestrogen, FSH, and other hormones. No wonder these hormones play an essential role during the IVF treatment. 
  2. Interference with IVF medicines: IVF medications like fertility drugs, hormonal supplements, etc., can come in contact with alcohol. Thus, it can hamper the absorption, efficacy, as well as metabolism of these IVF medicines and can lower the effectiveness and lead to serious ill-effects.
  3. Low chances of positive development of the embryo: The embryo's development can be halted due to alcohol consumption. Further, it can increase the chances of chromosomal abnormalities, miscarriage, and poor implantation. 
  4. High level of stress and anxiety: Opting for IVF treatment demands much more than your capacity. The inclusion of alcohol consumption can increase stress and anxiety levels. It can negatively impact the IVF process and lead to poor outcomes.  

Alcohol intake: Risks involved after IVF treatment

Here are some risks involved in consuming alcohol after having an IVF treatment: 

  • Impaired embryo implantation: After the transfer of the embryo, if you are consuming alcohol, then it can hamper the process. The uterine lining plays an essential role in the easy implantation process. But with alcohol consumption, development and receptivity can be hampered, which can minimise the chances of pregnancy.
  • Pregnancy issues: Alcohol consumption, even in minor amounts, can lead to various pregnancy issues like preterm labour, birth defects, placental issues, and much more. All of these issues can leave lasting effects on the mother as well as the baby.
  • High risks of miscarriage: If an IVF pregnancy is achieved, alcohol consumption should be stopped. However, if it still persists, then miscarriage chances can be possible. This can leave detrimental effects and cause pregnancy loss due to uneven embryo as well as fetus development.
  • Ill-effects on foetal development: Not many people know, but alcohol is considered to be a teratogen. It can result in birth defects as well as fetal development issues. This can leave a lifelong impact on the physical, behavioral, as well as cognitive health of the unborn child.
  • Maternal health issues: During IVF pregnancy, consumption of alcohol can negatively impact the health of the mother. This can even lead to gestational diabetes, high blood pressure, and various other issues. Thus, danger can be caused to the baby and the mother.
  • Altered medication efficacy: During the IVF pregnancy, women are put under certain medications to carry out a healthy pregnancy as well as the development of the fetus. But the involvement of alcohol during this time can hamper the efficacy of these medicines, leading to low effectiveness of the medicines and a high risk of various pregnancy complications.

Conclusion 

There is no denial about the fact that IVF cost in India can vary and sometimes can be expensive, depending on the medical condition. However, the consumption of alcohol can be detrimental before and after the IVF treatment. The above-mentioned points will help you understand the fertility issues faced by men and women if they consume alcohol during this procedure. Also, there are other risks that you need to go through and avoid making any mistakes that can risk the IVF pregnancy.

blogPosts.title: 8 Common Gut Health Myths Debunked
blogPosts.excerpt: Uncover the truth behind 8 common gut health myths. From bowel movements to Stress, learn what’s fact and what’s fiction for a healthier gut.
blogPosts.content:
Our digestive system is perhaps one of the most essential systems in our body. It processes whatever we eat, ingests all the nutritional elements, and converts the food into energy. It is the reason why we are able to function as normal humans. There are several misconceptions about one’s health in the common zeitgeist. With the help of the best gastro doctor in Ludhiana, you can thoroughly make sure that you are able to understand what is real and what is an urban myth. This is particularly true when you are suffering from an issue. 

If you are suffering from any sort of pain or discomfort in your stomach, it is essential to discern myth from reality in an effective manner. One can only seek gastroenterology treatment if they are aware of the symptoms and does not harbour any misconceptions regarding gut troubles and treatment possibilities. In this article, we aim to dispel some common misconceptions that exist around gut health and the possible treatment options that one can undertake. 

Myth #1: You must have bowel movements every day

Fact #1:

Many people widely believe that they have to have a bowel movement every single day to be deemed healthy. However, this is not at all important. What’s important is that one needs to be consistent with it. One can have a bowel movement three times a day or a week, but you need to make sure that the waste passed isn’t too solid or liquid. It is essential to ensure that you have consistent bowel movements, no matter how many times you have to go. 

Myth #2: Acid reflux is caused by spicy food 

Fact #2:

One might also be under the assumption that spicy food can effectively lead to acid reflux in an essential manner. At the same time, it is true that you can suffer from acid reflux in a thorough manner when you indulge in spicy foods. This is not the sole reason why one suffers from acid reflux. Acid reflux occurs when the stomach's acid thoroughly comes back into the person’s oesophagus in an essential manner. There are several factors that can effectively contribute to acid reflux, including obesity, certain medications, and indulging in large meals in a thorough manner. 

Myth #3: Fiber is always beneficial 

Fact #3:

Fiber is perhaps one of the most critical parts of our diets in an essential manner. When consumed correctly, it can thoroughly aid the process of digestion and offer a lot of benefits to your system in a critical manner. However, if you only consume fiber without making certain that you are taking the required amount of water alongside it, it can lead to issues for your digestive system. Issues such as bloating and gas are commonly associated with the wrong intake of fiber. Ensure to drink a lot of water alongside your fiber intake to ease the passage of fiber through your digestive tract. 

Myth #4: Ignoring symptoms is harmless 

Fact #4:

Most people tend to ignore minor inconveniences when it comes to the stomach. Instances such as bloating, changes in one’s bowel movement, as well as any abdominal pain, are ignored. One needs to make sure that you do not ignore these issues, as they can be an early symptom of diseases such as IBS and IBD, even celiac disease, and colon cancer. Therefore, if you or someone you know is suffering from any stomach-related issue and the symptoms persist, you need to see an expert as soon as possible. 

Myth #5: No dairy for lactose-intolerant people 

Fact #5:

If you know someone who is lactose intolerant, you might be under the assumption that they cannot drink or consume any dairy products at all. However, this is not the case. Most people who are lactose tolerant can indulge in some dairy products. The amount, however, varies from person to person. Some might be able to drink a glass of milk, while others can only do two and a half. 

Myth #6: Aging causes constipation 

Fact #6:

As people grow older, they tend to grow more and more constipated. However, the increase in the intensity of constipation rarely has anything to do with the body’s natural aging process. The truth is this: elderly people take a lot of medications. Some of them can thoroughly impact one’s metabolism, making it significantly slower. They are also less likely to exercise, which can reduce the body’s movement and ability to process food.

Myth #7: IBS is only related to your diet 

Fact #7:

If you are suffering from IBS, or irritable bowel syndrome, you might think that changes in your diet will be enough to address this issue once and for all. While changing your diet can thoroughly and actively help you to relieve specific symptoms, it won’t heal the condition. Even the act of eating can thoroughly exacerbate all your symptoms in an effective manner. By keeping a track of what you are eating and your eating habits, you can make sure to figure out what triggers the illness.   

Myth #8: Stress can cause ulcers 

Fact #8:

It was widely believed that being extremely stressed led to the development of ulcers in the stomach. However, studies conducted in the 1980s found that there is little to no connection between being stressed and developing ulcers in the intestinal lining. 

Conclusion 

Our digestive system is a complex and intricate system that requires proper maintenance and care for functioning. It is imperative to ensure that you are able to take gastroenterology treatment in Punjab if you are suffering from any gastric issues. However, for this, you need to make sure that you are able to dispel any misconceptions you might be holding with regard to your gut health and digestive tract. With this, you can ensure that you are able to thoroughly and actively understand when you are facing something worth raising concern over.

The idea of undergoing a reproductive organ change surgery is always a matter of personal choice, whether transitioning from male to female or vice versa. This process of gender reassignment is not done once; it is a process that involves a lot of steps in order to reach the desired goal. There are only two types of this surgical procedure, which are MTF and FTM surgery. This article stresses the complex procedure of transitioning from male to female and how individuals are supposed to mentally and physically prepare for it. 

Male to Female Transitioning 

This is when a man opts to transform his gender to become a woman. In this surgery, the physical features of a man are removed, like his genitals, the Adam's Apple, and his face is feminised. In order to completely become a woman, the man is given female organs and injected with hormones extracted from a woman to enable the cycle of menstruation and many other natural processes that women go through in their reproductive cycles. 

A woman's reproductive system is complex, and it requires a lot of changes to transform into a man. Certain processes in the male body have to be stopped usually by restraining medication, and this can consume a lot of time. The process of organ replacement is then safely initiated soon after all the processes are stopped. This surgery costs much more than the one where a man has to switch into a woman. The cost of transgender surgery in India can be known after consulting a specific hospital because it varies from one centre to another. The approximate amount is 2 lakh to 15 lakh INR. 

How to Prepare for a Gender Transformation Surgery? 

  • Obtain certification from a psychiatrist. 
  • Get two other confirmation documents from the psychiatrist 
  • Obtain an affidavit from the court for both the client and the surgeon. 
  • Inform the surgeon of any medication allergies. 
  • Tell the doctor if you are on some medication, even over-the-counter pills.
  • Follow the doctor's instructions regarding the presurgical medications. 
  • Consult the doctor in case one is stopping some medication. 
  • Pack necessary items like clothes, a toothbrush, a towel, slippers, and a robe. 
  • Adhere to the doctor's dietary instructions before the surgery.
  • Communicate any ailment to the doctor, like the flu and a cough. 
  • The doctor must be advised if you have any sexually transmitted diseases.

What to Do After Transgender Surgery? 

  • Avoid smoking 
  • Maintain a healthy diet
  • Avoid drinking alcohol 
  • Avoid cheese 
  • Do not bathe unless the doctor says otherwise 
  • Drink a lot of water 
  • Do not sleep facing downwards 

In a nutshell, the transformation from being male to female takes quite a while to reach the desired destination. The procedure is made easier when working with the right surgeon with the expertise of male to female surgery in Delhi. There are risks that follow the procedure like bleeding, pain, and swelling but they can be managed by taking prescribed medicine by the health care provider. Following care instructions after the procedure is essential for a speedy recovery.

It is essential to make sure that you are able to actively ensure that you can follow your doctor’s instructions in a critical manner. Your doctor will provide you with personalised recovery instructions. Therefore, by correctly following these instructions, you can easily ensure that you enhance your speed of recovery. 

Protect Your Eyes 

It is also vital to ensure that you can effectively protect your eyes in an essential manner. With the help of the right UV-protected sunglasses, you can make sure to prevent putting your eyes under any excessive amount of strain. 

Manage Your Discomfort 

In the aftermath of the surgery procedure, you can also thoroughly and actively experience a lot of discomfort in your eyes. However, it is also essential to be able to manage it. If the pain persists, you need to make sure that you can ask your doctor for the same.  

Be Patient 

It is further essential to be patient in your recovery period. By being impatient, you cannot do anything. Therefore, it is necessary to ensure that you are able to calm and collect your thoughts throughout the recovery procedure. 

Do Not Touch Your Eyes 

It is also essential to make sure that you do not touch your eyes. Your eyes are thoroughly sensitive to any type of touch during your recovery period. Therefore, it is essential to make sure that you are able to avoid touching your eyes. 

Conclusion 

Undergoing a LASIK surgery procedure can thoroughly prove to be an intimidating reality. However, the truth of the matter is that one can easily undergo this procedure in an essential manner without any worries. One also needs to make sure that they are able to thoroughly and actively explore the possibility of taking care of their eyes in the time after a LASIK surgery procedure in an effective manner. Easily make sure that you are able to recover properly from the procedure by incorporating the aforementioned tips into your routine without any prominent worries. 

If you are looking for LASIK surgery cost in India, it is essential to note that it depends on a case-by-case basis. Therefore, make sure to ask your doctor before you make a decision.

blogPosts.title: When is the Right Time to Visit a Sexologist? Top Signs to Know
blogPosts.excerpt: Wondering if you should see a sexologist? Discover the top signs it's time to seek expert help for sexual health, intimacy, or relationship concerns.
blogPosts.content:
A lot of relationships have had a bad ending due to unresolved sexual issues. People in India choose to stay quiet when it comes to discussing their sexual problems. This not only creates a rift between the partners but can also cause psychological trauma and stress. Also, a lack of awareness or knowledge can make everything seem difficult, and people can feel they are reaching no conclusion. This is why it is essential to understand that when you are unhappy with your sexual life or are facing various issues related to it, it is time to get in touch with the best sexologist in Jalandhar. This article will help you understand various situations where you are required to consult a sexologist. 

Top signs to visit a sexologist 

Whether you call them a sexual therapist or a sexologist, they can help you deal with various issues. Here are some signs that indicate it is time to visit a sexologist without any delay: 

Low sexual drive 

This situation appears when there is avoidance of getting intimate with the partner. It can happen due to hormonal changes, physiological issues, the use of specific medicines, and even fatigue. However, underlying issues can even cause a low sex drive. If you have been facing this issue for a long time, then it is better to consult a sexologist who can offer you the best help. 

Physiological issues 

Most men face erectile dysfunction, penetration problems, or premature ejaculation, while having a proper erection can make their sex life miserable. However, these issues can be handled with medical care. Visiting a sexologist can be beneficial in understanding the need to start treatment. In the case of women, issues like vaginal dryness, pre-menopause, vaginismus, etc., can lead to painful intercourse. All these issues can be discussed with a sexologist and treated at the right time. 

Intense sexual feelings that involves certain uneven objects 

No one should avoid having an open conversation about this issue. This is considered a serious problem and could be linked to psychological problems. Further, it can lead to social or occupational stress. Contacting the right sexologist can be beneficial. 

No alignment between sexual desires and requirements 

It is not possible for the partners to be on the same page every time during sex. There can be situations where one partner can have a low sex drive because of stress, hormonal issues, etc. To deal with it, having an open conversation about it can be helpful. If the issue persists, then visiting a sexologist as a couple becomes necessary. 

Obsession with sex

Being preoccupied with sexual thoughts can result in various problems in your life. It can hinder your work performance and overall functioning. Also, it can occur due to underlying psychological issues. During such situations, it is imperative to seek immediate help from a sexologist. The medical professional will get to the root of the problem and offer the best treatment. 

There is guilt about it. 

There are people who can experience constant guilt after having sex. The reasons behind this could be a bad sexual experience, child abuse, or any other issue related to it. No matter the problem, getting help from a sexologist can get you out of your guilt trip and allow you to indulge in positive sexual interactions. 

No sign of achieving an orgasm 

This issue can occur with most women. No wonder ejaculation and orgasm work simultaneously. Thus, if the situation occurs where you are unable to experience an orgasm despite having a loving and caring partner, then it is time to get in touch with a reputed sexologist who can provide you with the best treatments and solutions. 

Confusion related to sexual orientation 

This is not a common topic that most people discuss. For this reason, some people feel that they are trapped with the wrong identity. Thus, if you are unable to deal with the topic of sexual orientation, then it is essential to break the norms or stigma and get in contact with the best sexologist. 

Inability to perform

There are situations where everything feels right, but you are unable to perform well. Or there is a situation where you face painful intercourse. This can be an alarming sign that you should take seriously. During such situations, it is better to have an open conversation with a sexologist. 

Conclusion 

The best sexologist in India will lead you on a path of satisfactory desire and great sex life. There are many issues or situations like those discussed above that cannot be solved with the help of a medical professional or sexologist. Getting in touch with a sexologist will allow you to experience peace of mind, have an open discussion about your sexual issues, and get the best treatment. However, understanding the right time to visit a sexologist plays a major role. The signs defined above will do the trick and allow you to maintain a healthy sexual life.

blogPosts.title: Kidney Stones: Pre and Post Operative Guidelines to Follow
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover essential pre and post-operative guidelines for kidney stone treatment. Learn how to prepare for surgery, promote healing, and prevent future stones effectively.\n
blogPosts.content:
Facing the issue of kidney stones can make you feel overwhelmed and stressed at times. This is a problem where kidney stones are formed from substances like minerals, salts, etc., in your kidneys. They can be formed in various sizes and cause various problems. This issue can occur to anyone without any warning. However, it is essential to get the right treatment with the help of the best urologist in Ludhiana. 

In some cases, where kidney stones are small, they can pass out of the body naturally or by following a certain dietary regimen, but if the kidney stones are big, then they require an operative procedure or kidney stone surgery. This article will help you understand the pre- and post-operative care that is necessary to be followed by an individual who is undergoing kidney stone surgery. 

What complications can be faced due to kidney stones? 

Kidney stones can create a lot of complications in the regular routine of a person. However, if they are left untreated, then there is a possibility that urinary tract obstruction can occur. The common issues that can be faced during kidney stones are: 

  • Acute pain 
  • Blockage of urinary flow 
  • Urinary tract infections 
  • Kidney damage 
  • Hydronephrosis 
  • Sepsis 
  • Recurrent kidney stones

Kidney stones: The treatment options to opt for 

Kidney stones can be dealt with non-surgical treatments if the size is very small. During such treatment, certain management points can be followed, such as pain management, the use of certain medications, and watchful waiting. However, when it comes to managing kidney stones via surgery, here are some surgical options that can be opted for depending on an individual’s condition: 

  • Extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy: ESWL is a procedure that is considered to be non-invasive. There is involvement of shock waves in it, which is effective in breaking down the kidney stones.  This further helps the stones to get out of the body via urine. If you have small or medium-sized kidney stones then this procedure is for you. However, while conducting this surgery, the stones are possibly found in the urinary tract or kidneys. 
  • Percutaneous nephrolithotomy: PCNL is also a minimally invasive process, which is mostly opted for to get rid of large or complicated stones. The surgery is carried out by making a small hole in the back, and with the help of a nephroscope, the kidney stone removal process is done. 
  • Open surgery : Another method is open surgery. This method is opted for when other treatments fail. This process is done by making a big incision on the individual’s back or abdomen. The big-sized kidney stones or complicated ones are then removed. 
  • Ureteroscopy/RIRS: URS and RIRS are other kidney stone removal surgeries where insertion of a thin scope is done via the urethra as well as the bladder. This is done to get to the kidney or the ureter. Also, lasers or baskets are highly involved in this process for kidney stone removal. 

Kidney stone surgery: Pre-operative tips to be followed

Pre-operative care is all about taking the necessary measures that should be done before the surgery. The tips are effective in reducing any kind of risk that occurs during the surgery. Plus, they are beneficial for quick recovery. The surgical complications can also be avoided with these pre-op care tips. Thus, the following points should be followed religiously: 

  • No smoking and drinking: Before getting the kidney stone treatment or surgery, it is essential to quit smoking and reduce your alcohol intake. This needs to be done in advance so that the process can be carried out with success. The reason behind smoking hampers the respiratory system and can increase the chances of pneumonia after undergoing surgery. 
  • No food consumption before getting the surgery: Another thing to take care of before getting the kidney stone removal surgery is to avoid consuming anything. This is suggested by the doctors to not have anything after midnight the day before your surgery. The step needs to be followed so that the body remains safe during the anesthesia and no complications occur. Otherwise, the food in the stomach can come up as vomit during the anesthesia and result in damage to the lungs or choking. 
  • No drinks before getting the surgery: A few hours before the surgery, it is imperative not to have anything to drink, such as milk, a cold drink, etc. However, a few hours before the surgery, having water, tea, or black coffee is somehow safe to have. The doctors suggested avoiding drinking because it can lead to vomiting and create complications. 
  • Have a detailed conversation about medication: Taking blood-thinning medicines can create problems when you are opting for kidney stone surgery. This is why it is essential to get in touch with urologist and have a detailed conversation about your medication intake. Otherwise, catastrophic conditions can occur during the surgery and can even lead to loss of life. 

Kidney stone surgery: Post-operative tips to be followed 

For a healthy and quick recovery period, it is essential to follow the post-operative tips of kidney stone surgery. These are self-care tips that can allow you to be at ease without facing any issues, such as: 

  • Try to be active: When you are done with the kidney stone surgery, it is essential for your body to be active. However, it is also essential to strike a balance and try not to overdo any physical tasks. Try to show some restraint and religiously follow the instructions of the doctor to recover quickly. After getting the surgery, do not opt for a sedentary lifestyle. Ensure that you are following a light physical routine so that the recovery process becomes swift and smooth. 
  • Keep a check on your diet: Keeping a check on your diet is highly essential even post-surgery. Try not to indulge in smoking or drinking after a successful kidney stone surgery. Also, ensure that you are having a balanced meal and avoid having spicy food items for some days. As per the experts, it is essential to drink plenty of water every day. Avoid consuming dairy products for some days post-surgery. Ensure that you are consuming more fibre and vegetables so that your bowel movement does not get disturbed.

Conclusion 

Kidney stones can be detrimental to your health. Getting kidney stone surgery at the right time is imperative. However, things do not end with the surgery option. You need to be vigilant about the before-and-after care. The kidney stone treatment in Punjab can be understood with the help of this entire information. Ensure that you are following everything religiously so that you recover quickly. Also, proper consultation with your doctor should be done at every step.

blogPosts.title: ਮਰਦਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਧੀਆਂ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ (ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ) ਕੀ ਹੈ? ਕਾਰਣ, ਲੱਛਣ ਅਤੇ ਇਲਾਜ਼। ਡਾਕਟਰ ਤੋਂ ਜਾਣੋ
blogPosts.content:
ਮਰਦਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਾਰਮੋਨਲ ਅਸੰਤੁਲਨ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਈ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਪੈਦਾ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ (ਮਰਦਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਧੀਆਂ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ) ਵੀ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋ ਇੱਕ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਇੱਕ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਬਿਮਾਰੀ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਿਲਕੁਲ ਆਮ ਹੈ। ਮਰਦਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਯੌਵਨ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਤੇ ਬੁਢਾਪੇ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ। 

ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਕਿ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ? 

ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਨੂੰ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਦੀ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਵਜੋਂ ਵੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਅਸਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਫਿਰ ਮੁੰਡਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਟਿਸ਼ੂਆਂ ਦੀ ਮਾਤਰਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਾਧਾ ਹੈ। ਮਰਦਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਐਸਟ੍ਰੋਜਨ ਅਤੇ ਟੈਸਟੋਸਟੀਰੋਨ ਹਾਰਮੋਨਸ ਦਾ ਅਸੰਤੁਲਨ ਇਸ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਦ ਕਾਰਣ ਬਣਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਇੱਕ ਜਾਂ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ, ਤੇ ਕਈ ਵਾਰ ਅਸਮਾਨ ਰੂਪ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ।

ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਿਲਕੁਲ ਆਮ ਹੈ। ਜਿਸਦੇ ਕਾਰਣ ਇਸ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਤੋਂ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਆਕਾਰ ਆਮ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਵੱਧ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਮਰਦਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਆਕਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਾਧੇ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਣ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਔਰਤਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਵਾਂਗ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ। 

ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੱਸ ਦਈਏ ਕਿ ਇਹ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਬਿਲਕੁਲ ਔਰਤਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਵਾਂਗੂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਅਜਿਹੇ ਕੁੱਝ ਮਾਮਲਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਔਰਤਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਦਾ-ਜੁਲਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਇੱਕ ਆਦਮੀ ਦੇ ਪੇਸ਼ੇਵਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਅਤੇ ਉਸਦੇ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੋਨਾਂ ਤੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਮਾੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਪਾਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। 

ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਨਵਜੰਮੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ, ਜਵਾਨੀ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਲੰਘ ਰਹੇ ਮੁੰਡਿਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਵੱਡੀ ਉਮਰ ਦੇ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਾਰਮੋਨ ਦੇ ਪੱਧਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਤਬਦੀਲੀ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਣ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। ਮਰਦਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਹੋਰ ਵੀ ਕਾਰਣ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ। 

ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਕੋਈ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਨਜਿੱਠਣਾ ਮੁਸ਼ਕਲ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਖੋਜ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਮੁੰਡੇ ਅਕਸਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਮੂਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਜ਼ਾਕ ਦਾ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਬਣ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਜਿਹੜੇ ਕਿ ਇਸ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਤੋਂ ਪੀੜਿਤ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਵਾਲੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਈ ਵਾਰ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਰਦ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਮੁੰਡੇ ਦੇ ਆਤਮਵਿਸ਼ਵਾਸ ਅਤੇ ਉਸਨੂੰ ਸ਼ਰਮਿੰਦਗੀ ਮਹਿਸੂਸ ਕਰਵਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਇਹ ਜਾਨਲੇਵਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ ਪਰ ਇਹ  ਕਈ ਤਰੀਕਿਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੀ ਗੁਣਵੱਤਾ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ।

ਦਰਅਸਲ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਠੀਕ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜੇਕਰ ਅਜਿਹਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ, ਤਾਂ ਇਸਨੂੰ ਠੀਕ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਲਈ ਦਵਾਈ ਜਾਂ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਦੀ ਮਦਦ ਲਈ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। 

ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਣ 

ਅਸਲ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਕਈ ਕਾਰਣਾਂ ਕਰਕੇ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਹਲੇ ਕਾਰਣ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਹਾਰਮੋਨਲ ਅਸੰਤੁਲਨ ਹੈ। ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਜਦੋਂ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਹਾਰਮੋਨਲ ਅਸੰਤੁਲਨ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਟੈਸਟੋਸਟੀਰੋਨ ਹਾਰਮੋਨ ਦਾ ਪੱਧਰ ਐਸਟ੍ਰੋਜਨ ਹਾਰਮੋਨ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਘੱਟ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਦਰਅਸਲ ਮਰਦ ਬਹੁਤ ਘੱਟ ਮਾਤਰਾ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਐਸਟ੍ਰੋਜਨ ਹਾਰਮੋਨ ਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਾਣ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਜਦੋਂ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਦੇ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਐਸਟ੍ਰੋਜਨ ਹਾਰਮੋਨ ਦਾ ਪੱਧਰ ਬਹੁਤ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। 

ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਣਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਵਾਨੀ ਭਾਵ 15-18 ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ ਅਤੇ ਬੁਢਾਪਾ ਭਾਵ 50-80 ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ ਸ਼ਾਮਿਲ ਹੈ। ਇਸਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਦਾ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਈ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਦਵਾਈਆਂ ਵੀ ਬਣ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਇਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਾਮਿਲ ਹਨ :

  • ਦਿਲ ਦੀਆਂ ਦਵਾਈਆਂ। 
  • ਐਂਟੀ-ਚਿੰਤਾ ਦਵਾਈਆਂ।
  • ਐਂਟੀ-ਐਂਡਰੋਜਨ ਦਵਾਈਆਂ।
  • ADHD ਦਵਾਈਆਂ।
  • ਐਂਟੀਬਾਇਓਟਿਕਸ ਦਵਾਈਆਂ। 
  • ਅਲਸਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਦਵਾਈਆਂ। 
  • ਐਨਾਬੋਲਿਕ ਸਟੀਰੌਇਡ ਅਤੇ ਐਂਡਰੋਜਨ  ਦਵਾਈਆਂ। 
  • ਏਡਜ਼ ਦੀਆਂ ਦਵਾਈਆਂ।
  • ਕੀਮੋਥੈਰੇਪੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਦਵਾਈਆਂ।

ਕੁੱਝ ਪਦਾਰਥਾਂ ਦਾ ਸੇਵਨ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਵੀ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਪੈਦਾ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। 

  • ਗਾਂਜਾ ਦਾ ਸੇਵਨ ਕਰਨਾ। 
  • ਸ਼ਰਾਬ ਪੀਣਾ। 
  • ਹੈਰੋਇਨ ਦਾ ਸੇਵਨ। 
  • ਕਾਫ਼ੀ ਮੈਥਾਡੋਨ ਦਾ ਸੇਵਨ ਕਰਨਾ। 

ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਦੀ ਕੁਝ ਸਿਹਤ ਸਥਿਤੀਆਂ ਵੀ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਦਾ ਕਾਰਣ ਬਣ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ 

  • ਟਿਊਮਰ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਹੋਣਾ। 
  • ਹਾਈਪੋਗੋਨੇਡਿਜ਼ਮ ਹੋਣਾ। 
  • ਹਾਈਪੋਥਾਇਰਾਇਡਿਜ਼ਮ ਦਾ ਹੋਣਾ। 
  • ਜਿਗਰ ਦਾ ਸਿਰੋਸਿਸ ਜਾਂ ਅਸਫ਼ਲਤਾ ਹੋਣਾ। 
  • ਗੁਰਦੇ ਦਾ ਫੇਲ੍ਹ ਹੋਣਾ। 
  • ਕੁਪੋਸ਼ਣ ਦਾ ਸ਼ਿਕਾਰ ਹੋਣਾ। 

ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਦੇ ਲੱਛਣ 

  • ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਦੀ ਛਾਤੀ ਦੇ ਆਕਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਾਧਾ ਹੋਣਾ। 
  • ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਗੰਢ ਦਾ ਅਹਿਸਾਸ ਹੋਣਾ। 
  • ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਆਲੇ-ਦੁਆਲੇ ਸੋਜ ਹੋਣਾ। 
  • ਕੁਝ ਮਾਮਲਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਨਫੈਕਸ਼ਨ ਦਾ ਹੋਣਾ। 
  • ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਮਲਤਾ ਦੀ ਭਾਵਨਾ ਹੋਣਾ।
  • ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਲਕਾ ਦਰਦ ਹੋਣਾ। 
  • ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਦੇ ਨਿੱਪਲ ਸੰਵੇਦਨਸ਼ੀਲ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ। 

ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਦਾ ਇਲਾਜ਼ 

ਦਰਅਸਲ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਦਾ ਇਲਾਜ਼ ਇਸਦੇ ਗ੍ਰੇਡ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਦੇ ਕੁੱਝ ਮਾਮਲਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਿਲਕੁਲ ਇਲਾਜ਼ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਜਦੋਂ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਆਪਣੇ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤੀ ਪੜਾਅ ਤੇ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਡਾਕਟਰ ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਜੀਵਨਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਅਤੇ ਖੁਰਾਕ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੁੱਝ ਸਕਾਰਾਤਮਕ ਬਦਲਾਅ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਸੁਝਾਅ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ, 

  • ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਮੇਂ ਸਿਰ ਸੌਣਾ ਅਤੇ ਉੱਠਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। 
  • ਆਪਣੀ ਡਾਈਟ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਰੀਆਂ ਪੱਤੇਦਾਰ ਸਬਜ਼ੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਜ਼ੇ ਫਲਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕਰਨਾ। 
  • ਸਵੇਰ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਾਮ ਨੂੰ ਹਲਕੀ ਕਸਰਤ ਦਾ ਕਰਨਾ। 
  • ਸ਼ਰਾਬ, ਸਿਗਰਟ ਜਾਂ ਹੋਰ ਨਸ਼ੀਲੇ ਪਦਾਰਥਾਂ ਦੇ ਸੇਵਨ ਤੋਂ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਆਦਿ ਸ਼ਾਮਿਲ ਹੈ। 

ਇਸਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ ਡਾਕਟਰ ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਨੂੰ ਫਾਸਟ ਫੂਡ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਲਡ ਡਰਿੰਕਸ ਦਾ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਸੇਵਨ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਣ ਲਈ ਕਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਇਸਦੇ ਕੁੱਝ ਮਾਮਲਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਜੇਕਰ ਖ਼ੁਰਾਕ ਅਤੇ ਜੀਵਨਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਕਾਰਾਤਮਕ ਬਦਲਾਅ ਕੰਮ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦੇ ਜਾਂ ਫਿਰ ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਨੂੰ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਗ੍ਰੇਡ-3 ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਾਮਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਡਾਕਟਰ ਦਵਾਈਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।

ਦਰਅਸਲ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਦੀ ਸਰਜਰੀ  ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਦੋ ਤਰੀਕੇ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਹਿਲੀ ਲਿਪੋਸਕਸ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਮਾਸਟੈਕਟੋਮੀ। 

1. ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਲਿਪੋਸਕਸ਼ਨ ਦੇ ਸਮੇਂ, ਸਰਜਨ ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਦੀ ਛਾਤੀ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਵਾਧੂ ਚਰਬੀ ਨੂੰ ਹਟਾ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਦਰਅਸਲ ਲਿਪੋਸਕਸ਼ਨ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਦੇ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਦੀ ਛਾਤੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਟਾਇਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ।

2. ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ, ਮਾਸਟੈਕਟੋਮੀ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਦੇ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਦੀ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਹਟਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਦਰਅਸਲ ਮਾਸਟੈਕਟੋਮੀ ਦੀ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਐਂਡੋਸਕੋਪੀ ਦੀ ਮਦਦ ਨਾਲ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 

ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੀ ਰੋਕਥਾਮ

  • ਸ਼ਰਾਬ ਦਾ ਸੇਵਨ ਸੀਮਤ ਕਰੋ ਜਾਂ ਫਿਰ ਬੰਦ ਕਰੋ। 
  • ਨਿਯਮਿਤ ਤੌਰ ਕਸਰਤ ਕਰੋ। 
  • ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾਤਰ ਆਪਣੀ ਖੁਰਾਕ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਫਲ ਅਤੇ ਸਬਜ਼ੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕਰੋ। 
  • ਸੰਤੁਲਿਤ ਖੁਰਾਕ ਦਾ ਸੇਵਨ ਕਰੋ। 
  • ਆਪਣੇ ਸਿਹਤਮੰਦ ਵਜ਼ਨ ਨੂੰ ਬਣਾ ਕੇ ਰੱਖੋ। 
  • ਕੋਈ ਵੀ ਦਵਾਈ ਡਾਕਟਰ ਦੀ ਸਲਾਹ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਨਾ ਲਵੋ। 
  • ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦਵਾਈਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਲਵੋ ਜੋ ਡਾਕਟਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਦੱਸੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। 

ਸਿੱਟਾ

ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਇੱਕ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਬਿਮਾਰੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਹੜੀ ਕਿ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਛਾਤੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਆਕਾਰ ਆਮ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਐਸਟ੍ਰੋਜਨ ਅਤੇ ਟੈਸਟੋਸਟੀਰੋਨ ਹਾਰਮੋਨਸ ਦੇ ਅਸੰਤੁਲਨ ਕਾਰਣ ਪੈਦਾ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਯੌਵਨ ਅਤੇ ਬੁਢਾਪੇ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਨੂੰ ਠੀਕ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਲਈ ਡਾਕਟਰ ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਜੀਵਨਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਖ਼ੁਰਾਕ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲਾਵ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਸਲਾਹ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਖ਼ੁਰਾਕ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਜੀਵਨਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲਾਵ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਵੀ ਇਸ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਹੋਂ ਤਾਂ ਡਾਕਟਰ 

ਦਵਾਈਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਦੀ ਸਲਾਹ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ,  ਜਿਸਦੀ ਮਦਦ ਨਾਲ ਇਸ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਠੀਕ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਵੀ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਵਰਗੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਿਕਾਰ ਹੋਂ, ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਦਾ ਇਲਾਜ ਕਰਵਾਉਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋਂ,ਤੇ ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰਨਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋਂ, ਤਾਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਅੱਜ ਹੀ ਕਲੀਨਿਕ ਬਾਇ ਚੁਆਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਕੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਅਪੋਇੰਟਮੈਂਟ ਨੂੰ ਬੁੱਕ ਕਰਵਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋਂ ਅਤੇ ਇਸਦੇ ਇਲਾਜ਼ ਬਾਰੇ ਇਸਦੇ ਮਾਹਿਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋਂ। 

ਅਕਸਰ ਪੁੱਛੇ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਵਾਲ: 

ਸਵਾਲ 1. ਕੀ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਠੀਕ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ?

ਜੀ ਹਾਂ ਬਿਲਕੁਲ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਠੀਕ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਸਰਤ, ਖੁਰਾਕ, ਦਵਾਈਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਸਮੇਤ ਕਈ ਇਲਾਜ਼ ਉਪਲੱਬਧ ਹਨ। 

ਸਵਾਲ 2. ਕੀ ਮਰਦਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦਾ ਜੈਨੇਟਿਕਸ ਕਾਰਣ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ?

ਹਾਂ, ਕੀਤੀ ਖੋਜ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ, ਕੁੱਝ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਜੈਨੇਟਿਕ ਕਾਰਣਾਂ ਕਰਕੇ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। 

ਸਵਾਲ 3. ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ?

ਦਰਅਸਲ, ਗਾਇਨੇਕੋਮਾਸਟੀਆ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਦੋ ਤਰੀਕਿਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਪਹਿਲੀ ਲਿਪੋਸਕਸ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਮਾਸਟੈਕਟੋਮੀ। ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਦੇ ਦੌਰਾਨ, ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਦੀ ਛਾਤੀ ਦੇ ਆਲੇ-ਦੁਆਲੇ ਇੱਕ ਛੋਟਾ ਜਿਹਾ ਚੀਰਾ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਉੱਥੇ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਵਾਧੂ ਚਰਬੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਰਜਰੀ ਦੀ ਮਦਦ ਨਾਲ ਬਾਹਰ ਕੱਢ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ
