blogPosts.title: Find the Right Eye Care With Clinic by Choice
blogPosts.excerpt: Looking for quality eye care? Clinic by Choice helps you choose the best eye specialists and clinics based on your needs and location.
blogPosts.content:
There is no denying that our eyes play a major role in navigating the world around us. Our eyes are an essential sense organ that should be looked after from time to time. Most people often take eye care lightly, which can cause certain eye or vision impairments. With the passing time, the quality of eyes deteriorates without any proper care. This is why eye care should be given optimal importance with the help of the best eye specialists in India. 

However, finding the right eye specialist can be a daunting task and consumes a lot of time. But not with Clinic by Choice. We provide complete information about the leading eye specialists in India, all under one roof. We help you narrow down your eye care specialist search so that you can quickly move on with the required eye treatment. 

Why is eye care essential for all? 

The eye problems can come knocking at your door without any warning. Looking after your eyes can help in avoiding various serious eye issues like cataracts, glaucoma, etc. Plus, it can help with vision blurriness and much more. An eye specialist can help in prioritising your eye care, such as: 

  • Minimum risk of eye diseases: Eye care can be initiated with routine analysis, which can be beneficial in minimizing the risk of certain eye issues. The eye specialists perform a detailed analysis of the eye and offer complete treatment depending on the situation. Routine eye check-ups are mandatory for every person irrespective of the group. These check-ups can help in enhancing the health of your eyes.
  • Low risk of eye injury: Opting for appropriate eyewear or the right treatment can be beneficial in avoiding 90% of the possible eye injuries. Also, with the help of the right treatment, the right eyeglasses, or contact lenses, you will be able to see clearly without any eye problems. However, eye specialists suggest the right goggles or eyewear even for kids while doing any athletic activities. This is important to protect them from eye injuries. 
  • Quick and early diagnosis: Routine eye care with the help of the best eye specialist is highly imperative. It is essential for early diagnosis as well as treatment required during vision changes. However, if there is a change in the vision, it indicates that the prescription or the glasses need to be changed. In some cases, squinting of the eye or abnormal vision can be detected. 
  • Diagnosis of unknown eye issues: The underlying eye issues can affect the eyes in the long run. This is why getting your eyes diagnosed by a specialist at the right time is highly essential for all. 

What are the common eye treatments? 

There are different eye treatments that can be opted for by an individual depending on their eye condition and suggested by an eye expert. Some of the common eye treatments are: 

  • Corrective lenses: Corrective lenses are a common eye treatment which makes the life of an individual simple. With this treatment, the need to wear glasses, contact lenses, etc. can be avoided. Also, this treatment is suggested when a person is facing farsightedness, vision problems, etc. Plus, the issue of light on the retina can be corrected with it. 
  • Laser surgery: This is an essential treatment if the eye issues are very prominent and cannot be treated with medications. The eye specialists suggest LASIK or PRK surgery to correct refractive errors, the need to wear glasses or contact lenses, etc. Also, there are other procedures involved to treat glaucoma, etc. 
  • Surgical treatments: Depending on the eye issues, the eye specialists can suggest various surgical procedures like glaucoma surgery, vitrectomy, cataract surgery, retinal detachment surgery, and others. 
  • Medications: For eye issues that are less intense, certain medications are suggested by a specialist, such as eye drops for infectious or dry eyes. Also, oral medication is suggested for glaucoma and similar eye problems. 

Clinic by Choice: Making eye care easier for you 

Taking your eye care lightly can lead to major eye problems and cause you vision difficulties. Also, finding the right eye specialist when you need it the most can be hard to deal with. But with the help of Clinic by Choice, you do not have to worry about anything. For optimal eye care, we provide you with thorough information regarding the best eye care specialists in India. Thus, we simplify your search and provide everything under one roof.

blogPosts.title: डायबिटीज के कारण होने वाली आंखों की समस्याओं को कम करने के लिए अपनाएं ये 7 टिप्स, कम होगा खतरा
blogPosts.excerpt: डायबिटीज के कारण होने वाली आंखों की समस्याओं को रोकने और सुधारने के लिए जानें 7 प्रभावी टिप्स, जो आपके दृष्टि स्वास्थ्य को बेहतर बनाएंगे और खतरे को कम करेंगे।
blogPosts.content:
डायबिटीज की समस्या इन दिनों बहुत से लोगों को प्रभावित कर रही है।आजकल बहुत से लोगों इस समस्या से पीड़ित हैं। वैसे तो व्यक्ति को डायबिटीज होने के कई कारण हो सकते हैं, जैसे की खराब लाइफस्टाइल, ज्यादा मीठे का सेवन करना, पोषक तत्वों की कमी और तनाव आदि। एक व्यक्ति को डायबिटीज होने पर कई तरह के लक्षण दिखाई दे सकते हैं, जैसे कि उसको बार बार पेशाब आना, बहुत ज्यादा प्यास लगना और ज्यादा भूख लगना आदि। 

आपको बता दे की डायबिटीज में व्यक्ति के खून में ग्लूकोज के स्तर का कंट्रोल नहीं होता है। यह एक गंभीर स्थिति है जो कई और समस्याओं का कारण हो सकती है, जैसे दिल की बीमारी, आँखों की समस्या, और किडनी की समस्या। इसलिए डायबिटीज होने पर ब्लड शुगर के लेवल को नियंत्रित रखना बहुत जरूरी होता है। जो व्यक्ति डायबिटीज की समस्या से पीड़ित होते हैं उन लोगों को ज़्यादातर आँखों की रेटिना से जुडी समस्याएं होती हैं। अगर समय रहते आँखों का ध्यान न रखा जाए तो इस से आंखों की रोशनी भी प्रभावित हो सकती हैं। इस लेख के द्वारा जानते हैं की आखिर डायबिटीज में आंखों से जुड़ी समस्याओं को कम करने के लिए किन चीजों को अपनाना चाहिए। 

डायबिटीज से आंखों में कौन सी समस्याएं हो सकती हैं ?

  • डायबिटिक रेटिनोपैथी समस्या। 
  • मोतियाबिंद की समस्या। 
  • ग्लूकोमा की समस्या। 
  • डायबिटीज मैक्युलर एडिमा समस्या।

डायबिटीज से जुड़ी आँखों की समस्याओं के लक्षण क्या है?

  • व्यक्ति की नज़र कमजोर हो जाती है। 
  • धूप या उजाले में देखने में मुश्किल 
  • धुंधली नज़र का अनुभव होना।
  • अंधेरे या रोशनी में नज़र में कमी होना।
  • रंगों की पहचान करना मुश्किल होना।
  • आंखों में दर्द का अनुभव होना।
  • आंखों से पानी निकलना।
  • आंखों के आसपास सूजन होना।

डायबिटीज में आंखों से जुड़ी समस्याओं को कम करने के लिए टिप्स

  1. घर पर ब्लड शुगर की जांच करें

अगर आपको अपनी डायबिटीज की समस्या के बारे में पता चल जाता है तो अपनी ब्लड शुगर को ज्यादा बढ़ने न दें। इस तरह की स्थिति में घर पर ही एक किट लाकर अपनी डायबिटीज की नियमित जांच करते रहे। इसका उपयोग करके आप आप आसानी से अपने ब्लड शुगर का पता लगा पाएंगे। ज्यादा ब्लड शुगर होने पर आपको तुरंत अपने डॉक्टर को दिखाना चाहिए। 

  1. ब्लड शुगर में सुधार करें 

अगर आपको डायबिटीज की समस्या से आंखों से जुड़ी समस्या उत्पन्न हो गयी है तो इसके बारे में अपने डॉक्टर को बताएं। डायबिटीज में आंखों से जुड़ी समस्याओं को कम करने के लिए ब्लड शुगर को नियंत्रित होना बहुत जरूरी होता है। आँखों की रेटिनोपैथी का खतरा कम हो जाता है, जब ब्लड शुगर का लेवल कम होता है। अगर आपके ब्लड शुगर लेवल में उतार चढ़ाव होता है तो आप अपने डॉक्टर से सम्पर्क करें। 

  1. हेल्दी डाइट 

हेल्दी डाइट का सेवन करना हमारी पूरी सेहत के लिए बहुत जरूरी होता है। ब्लड शुगर जैसी समस्याओं में हेल्दी डाइट को खाना जरूरी होता है क्योंकि यह ब्लड शुगर लेवल को कंट्रोल करने में लाभदायक सिद्ध होता है। हेल्दी डाइट जैसे की साबुत अनाज, हरी सब्जियां और नट्स का सेवन किया जाता है। इन को अपनी डाइट में शामिल करने से ब्लड शुगर लेवल कंट्रोल होता है और साथ ही यह रक्तचाप, कोलेस्ट्रॉल और ट्राइग्लिसराइड्स के लेवल को नियंत्रित रखता है। 

  1. सीधी धूप से दूर रहें

जो लोग डायबिटीज की समस्या से पीड़ित हैं, इस दौरान आंखों की देखभाल करते वक़्त वह इस बात का ख़ास तौर पर ध्यान रखें की उनकी आंखों पर सीधी धूप न पड़ें। डायबिटीज के मरीजों को धूप में जाने से पहले सनग्लास जरूर पहनेने चाहिए। और इस दौरान अपनी नंगी आंखों से धूप को सीधा न देखे। अपने गंदे हाथों से अपनी आँखों को बार बार न छुएं और हाइजीन का भी ख्याल रखें।

  1. आंखों की नियमित जांच करवाएं

कोई समस्या न होने पर भी आंखों की नियमित जाँच करवाना बहुत जरूरी होता है और ख़ास तौर पर डायबिटीज के मरीजों को अपनी आंखों की समस्याओं से बचाने के लिए आंखों की नियमित डॉक्टर से जांच करवानी चाहिए। ऐसा करने पर आप समय से पहले आंखों से जुड़ी समस्या का पता लगा सकते हैं जिससे कई तरह की गंभीर समस्याओं से अपना बचाव किया जा सकता है। 

  1. नियमित व्यायाम करें

रोजाना शारीरिक गतिविधि डायबिटीज के लेवल को कंट्रोल करती है और समग्र स्वास्थ्य को अच्छा बनाने में मदद करती है। जिससे डायबिटीज से जुडी जटिलताओं का जोखिम कम होता है। आपको मध्यम तीव्रता वाले व्यायाम से शुरुआत करनी चाहिए और उन्हें करते वक्त आपको असुविधा हो रही है, तो अपने डॉक्टर से सम्पर्क करें। डॉक्टर आपको इसके बारे में जानकारी देंगे की मधुमेह के साथ सुरक्षित तरीके से व्यायाम कैसे करें।

  1. धूम्रपान को छोड़ें

आपको बता दें कि धूम्रपान करने से मधुमेह की जटिलतायें और भी ज्यादा बढ़ सकती हैं, जिसमें आपकी आँखों की समस्या भी जुड़ी हुई है। अगर आप अपने धूम्रपान को छोड़ने की कोशिश कर रहें हैं तो आप डॉक्टर से सम्पर्क कर सकते हैं। 

निष्कर्ष

आम तौर पर आज के समय में डायबिटीज की समस्या तेजी से अपने पैर पसार रही हैं। और कई लोग इस समस्या से पीड़ित हैं। जो व्यक्ति डायबिटीज की समस्या से पीड़ित होते हैं उन लोगों को ज़्यादातर आँखों की रेटिना से जुडी समस्याएं होने लगती हैं। अगर समय रहते आँखों की देखभाल न हो तो आंखों की रोशनी भी प्रभावित हो सकती हैं। डायबिटीज में आँखों से जुड़ी समस्याओं को कम करने के लिए आप नियमित व्यायाम करें, धूम्रपान को छोड़ें, सीधी धूप से दूर रहें, हेल्दी डाइट, आंखों की नियमित जांच कराएं, ब्लड शुगर में सुधार करें और घर पर ब्लड शुगर की जांच आदि चीजों को अपना सकते हैं। अगर आपकी डायबिटीज आपसे कण्ट्रोल नहीं हो रही है या फिर गंभीर हो गई है और आप इसका इलाज ढूंढ रहे हैं तो आप आज ही क्लीनिक बाय चॉइस जाकर अपनी अपॉइंटमेंट को बुक करवा सकते हैं और इसके विशेषज्ञों से इसके बारे में जानकारी को प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

blogPosts.title: Dental Care: Contribution To Your Overall Health
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover essential tips to enhance your dental care and boost your overall health. Learn effective practices for a brighter smile and better well-being.
blogPosts.content:
Teeth are considered the most significant organ of our body, helpful in breaking down food for our digestive system. However, as time passes, there are several problems like cavities and sensitivity that can originate, leading to bad dental health. Consequently, maintaining good oral health can help you in preventing such challenges. Furthermore, finding the best dental clinics can be a daunting task, but not with a Clinic By Choice. We provide you with the best medical healthcare providers with the aim of improving health conditions. 

What Are The Major Benefits Of Maintaining Good Oral Health?

The regular maintenance of your teeth plays a vital role in the well-being of your life. Dental care includes brushing regularly and periodic dental checkups to prevent dental problems such as tooth decay and cavities. These are discussed below in detail:

Protection From Oral Diseases

Usually, after eating, the food particles or plaque get stuck between your teeth, which can’t be removed by brushing only once a day. The plaque might still be present around your gums. It can lead to oral infection. To reduce the risk of this, brushing twice a day is necessary. In addition to it, regular dental checkups are required. Moreover, it lowers the chance of cavities. Additionally, flossing can do a much better job of cleaning teeth of areas where toothbrushes can’t even reach.

Leads to a Good Physical Health

Our mouth is the first organ through which all the impurities enter the body. In this context, the germs in our mouth can pass into the other parts of our body, which can result in bad breathing and diseases related to the heart. However, dental care will prevent you from such diseases and infections by identifying the problems at an early stage. 

Helpful for Pregnant Women

During pregnancy, a woman might experience the development of gingivitis due to hormonal changes, which can result in swollen gums and bleeding gums. Therefore, such risks can be lessened by dental inspection and good oral hygiene.

How To Maintain Oral Hygiene With A Professional’s Help?

Dental care plays a vital role in directing you towards a healthy lifestyle. However, sometimes brushing can no longer protect you from dental issues. Consequently, it is mandatory to seek the help of professionals in teeth cleaning once a year. It is especially advised for a person with braces and current dental implants. The treatments provided by the dentists are given below:-

  • The dentists remove the plaque with the help of some special tools. Your teeth will remain secure from gum infections.
  • They make the enamel stronger by providing fluoride treatment. Hence, preventing teeth from cavities. This is good for children, but adults can also go for this treatment.
  • The protective layer called dental sealants is applied over the teeth located at the back. It is done to save the teeth from germs.
  • X-rays are done sometimes to get to the core of the existing problems, such as gum infections and many more.

blogPosts.title: ਅੱਖਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਬੰਧਤ ਇਹ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਮ ਹਨ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਰੋਕਥਾਮ ਬਾਰੇ ਡਾਕਟਰ ਤੋਂ ਜਾਣੋ
blogPosts.excerpt: ਜਾਣੋ ਕਿ ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਮ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਰੋਕਥਾਮ ਲਈ ਡਾਕਟਰ ਕੀ ਸਲਾਹ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ।
blogPosts.content:
ਅੱਖਾਂ ਸਾਡੇ ਸਰੀਰ ਦਾ ਨਾਜ਼ੁਕ ਅਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਬਹੁਤ ਹੀ ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਣ ਅੰਗ ਹਨ। ਅੱਖਾਂ ਸਵੇਰੇ ਤੋਂ ਲੈਕੇ ਰਾਤ ਤੱਕ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਰੁਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਥੱਕੇ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਅੱਖਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਦੀ ਜਿੰਦਗੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਵੀ ਰੰਗ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ। ਇਸਦੇ ਲਈ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਦੇਖਭਾਲ ਕਰਨਾ ਬਹੁਤ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਜਰੂਰੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਮਾਪਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਆਪਣੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਲੱਛਣਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਹੀ ਸਮੇਂ 'ਤੇ ਪਛਾਣ ਕਰਕੇ ਢੁਕਵੇਂ ਕਦਮ ਚੁੱਕਣ। ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਕਿਸਮ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ, ਬੱਚੇ ਇਸ ਗੱਲ ਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਮਝਦੇ। ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਜੇਕਰ ਮਾਂ ਬਾਪ ਵੀ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਦੇ ਉੱਪਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਦੇਣਾ ਬੰਦ ਕਰ ਦੇਣ, ਤਾਂ ਬੱਚੇ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਭਵਿੱਖ ਵਿੱਚ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਮਣਾ ਵੀ ਕਰਨਾ ਪੈ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੱਸ ਦਈਏ ਕਿ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਨਮ ਦੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਤੋਂ ਹੀ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾਪਣ ਅਤੇ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਤੇਜ਼ੀ ਨਾਲ ਵੱਧ ਰਹੀਆਂ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਤੇ ਪੋਸ਼ਣ ਵਰਗੇ ਕਾਰਕ ਜਿੰਮੇਵਾਰ ਹਨ। ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੱਸ ਦਈਏ ਕਿ ਭਾਰਤ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ੇ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਅੰਨ੍ਹੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਲਗਭਗ 20 ਲੱਖ ਹੈ। ਜਿਆਦਾਤਰ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਆਮਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਮ ਸਿਹਤ ਅਤੇ ਪੋਸ਼ਣ ਦੀ ਘਾਟ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਣਾਂ ਕਰਕੇ ਹੋ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ। ਆਓ ਇਸ ਲੇਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਜਾਣਦੇ ਹਾਂ। 

ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਬੰਧਤ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਆਮ ਹਨ। 

ਸਾਰੇ ਮਾਪਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਹਤਮੰਦ ਅਤੇ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤ ਰੱਖਣ ਦੇ ਲਈ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਰੱਖਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਲੱਛਣਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਹੀ ਸਮੇਂ ਤੇ ਪਛਾਣ ਕਰਕੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਜੋਖਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਘੱਟ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ। ਡਾਕਟਰਾਂ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਆਮਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਐਨਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਜ਼ਰੂਰਤ, ਕਮਜ਼ੋਰ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਅਤੇ ਇਨਫੈਕਸ਼ਨ ਵਰਗੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਖ਼ਤਰਾ ਬਹੁਤ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜੇਕਰ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਨਜ਼ਰਅੰਦਾਜ਼ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ਭਵਿੱਖ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਪਾ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੀ ਖ਼ੁਰਾਕ ਅਤੇ ਜੀਵਨ ਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲਾਵ ਕਰਨ ਨਾਲ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਜੋਖਮ ਨੂੰ ਘੱਟ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। 

ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਬੰਧਤ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਖ਼ਤਰਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। 

1. ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਲਾਲੀ:

ਆਮਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਾਲੀ ਕਈ ਕਾਰਣਾਂ ਕਰਕੇ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਬਹੁਤ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਮੋਬਾਈਲ ਫੋਨ ਤੇ ਔਨਲਾਈਨ ਸਮਾਂ ਬਿਤਾਉਣਾ ਅਤੇ  ਧੁੱਪ, ਧੂੜ, ਆਦਿ ਦੇ ਸੰਪਰਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਉਣ ਆਦਿ। 

2. ਅੱਖਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਖੁਜਲੀ: 

ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾਤਰ ਬੱਚੇ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਨੰਗੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਬਾਹਰ ਘੁੰਮਦੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ।  ਜਿਸਦੇ ਕਾਰਣ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਈ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਇਸਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਖੁਜਲੀ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਹੋਣਾ ਸ਼ਾਮਿਲ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਐਲਰਜੀ, ਬੈਕਟੀਰੀਆ ਦੀ ਲਾਗ ਜਾਂ ਵਾਇਰਲ ਲਾਗ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਣ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। 

3. ਅੱਖਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਪਾਣੀ ਆਉਣਾ:

ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾਤਰ ਮਾਮਲਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਵਿਚੋਂ ਪਾਣੀ ਆਉਣ ਦਾ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਿਸੇ ਲਾਗ ਦਾ ਲੱਛਣ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

4. ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦਾ ਛਿੱਲਣਾ: 

ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦਾ ਛਿੱਲਣਾ ਆਮਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਗੱਲ ਦਾ ਸੰਕੇਤ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਕਿ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਬੱਚੇ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਟਾਮਿਨ ਡੀ ਦੀ ਕਮੀ ਹੈ, ਜਾਂ ਫਿਰ ਉਸਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਪੋਸ਼ਣ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਹਨ।

ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਬਚਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ?

1. ਸਕ੍ਰੀਨ ਸਮੇਂ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ: 

ਆਮਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਤਾ -ਪਿਤਾ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਖਿਆਲ ਰੱਖਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਆਦਾਤਰ ਸਮਾਂ ਔਨਲਾਈਨ ਸਕਰੀਨ ਤੇ ਨਾ ਬਿਤਾਵੇ। ਇਹ ਸਿਹਤ ਅਤੇ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਲਈ ਨੁਕਸਾਨਦੇਹ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਕ੍ਰੀਨ ਸਮੇਂ ਨੂੰ ਕੰਟਰੋਲ ਕਰਨਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ, ਖ਼ਾਸ ਕਰਕੇ ਔਨਲਾਈਨ ਗੇਮਾਂ ਖੇਡਣ ਅਤੇ ਟੀਵੀ ਦੇਖਣ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਿਤਾਏ ਗਏ ਸਮੇਂ ਨੂੰ ਘਟਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। 

2. ਨਿਯਮਤ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ: 

ਮਾਂ ਬਾਪ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਦੇਖਭਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਨਿਯਮਤ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰਵਾਉਣਾ ਬਹੁਤ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਜਰੂਰੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਇਹ ਸਮੇਂ ਸਿਰ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਸੰਭਾਵੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਹੀ ਇਲਾਜ਼ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। 

3. ਸਿਹਤਮੰਦ ਖਾਣਾ: 

ਮਾਪਿਆਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਮਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਸਿਹਤਮੰਦ ਖੁਰਾਕ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਖੁਰਾਕ ਨੂੰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਟਾਮਿਨ ਏ, ਸੀ, ਡੀ ਅਤੇ ਜ਼ਿੰਕ ਆਦਿ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੋਣੇ ਬਹੁਤ ਜਰੂਰੀ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਆਮਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਪੌਸ਼ਟਿਕ ਤੱਤ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਲਈ ਬਹੁਤ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ। 

4. ਸਫਾਈ ਦੀ ਦੇਖਭਾਲ: 

ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਰੀਰ ਦੀ ਸਫਾਈ ਦਾ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਰੱਖਣ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾਤਰ ਚੰਗੀ ਸਫਾਈ ਨਾ ਰੱਖਣ ਤੇ ਵੀ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਮਾਰੀਆਂ ਲੱਗ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸਹੀ ਦੇਖਭਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਸਫ਼ਾਈ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਲਾਗ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਮਦਦ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਸਿੱਟਾ

ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਵੱਡਿਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੋਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਇਹ ਗੱਲ ਅਲੱਗ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਇਸਦੇ ਲੱਛਣ ਵੱਖ ਵੱਖ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ। ਮਾਪਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਹਤਮੰਦ ਅਤੇ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤ ਰੱਖਣ ਦੇ ਲਈ, ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਦੇਖਭਾਲ ਕਰਨੀ ਜਰੂਰੀ ਹੈ। ਡਾਕਟਰਾਂ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਮਜ਼ੋਰ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਅਤੇ ਇਨਫੈਕਸ਼ਨ ਵਰਗੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਖ਼ਤਰਾ ਬਹੁਤ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸਹੀ ਸਮੇਂ ਤੇ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਕਰਕੇ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਘੱਟ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਹਨਾਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਜ਼ਰਅੰਦਾਜ ਕਰਨ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਭਵਿੱਖ ਤੇ ਮਾੜਾ ਅਸਰ ਪਾ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਆਮ ਸਿਹਤ ਅਤੇ ਪੋਸ਼ਣ ਦੀ ਘਾਟ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਣ ਇਹ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਤਪੰਨ ਹੁੰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਖੁਜਲੀ, ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦਾ ਛਿੱਲਣਾ, ਅੱਖਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਪਾਣੀ ਆਉਣਾ ਅਤੇ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਲਾਲੀ ਵਰਗੀਆਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਣ ਲਈ ਸਕ੍ਰੀਨ ਸਮੇਂ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਕਰਨਾ, ਸਿਹਤਮੰਦ ਖਾਣਾ, ਨਿਯਮਤ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਅਤੇ ਸਫਾਈ ਦੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਰੱਖਣਾ ਬਹੁਤ ਜਰੂਰੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਬੱਚੇ ਨੂੰ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਸਬੰਧਿਤ ਕੋਈ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ, ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇਸਦਾ ਇਲਾਜ਼ ਤੇ ਇਸਦੇ ਬਾਰੇ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਲੈਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋਂ, ਤਾਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਅੱਜ ਹੀ ਕਲੀਨਿਕ ਬਾਇ ਚੋਇਸ ਵਿਖੇ ਜਾਕੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਅਪੋਇੰਟਮੈਂਟ ਨੂੰ ਬੁੱਕ ਕਰਵਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋਂ ਅਤੇ ਇਸਦੇ ਮਾਹਿਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਇਸਦੇ ਇਲਾਜ਼ ਬਾਰੇ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਲੈ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋਂ।

blogPosts.title: Allergic Reaction: 10 Skincare Ingredients to Be Wary of
blogPosts.excerpt: Concerned about skincare allergies? Discover 10 common ingredients that can trigger allergic reactions and learn what to do if facing an allergic skin reaction.
blogPosts.content:
Your facial skin is the most sensitive part of your body. Being extra cautious with it is highly necessary for everyone. No wonder there are many skincare products that can seem to be helpful for your skin, but have you ever peeked into their ingredients list? Not every skincare product is meant for you, and not every skincare product is going to have a clean ingredient list. As a consumer, you have to be vigilant about the purchase and use of them. 

Otherwise, you may end up having allergic reactions involving severe rashes, painful or bumpy skin, acne, etc. Using your everyday skincare products blindly can trigger your skin barrier and can result in getting skin allergy treatment in Mumbai. This article will help you understand the skin ingredients that can be detrimental to your skin. 

Understanding an allergic skin reaction 

An allergic skin reaction can be experienced when your skin comes in direct contact with an ingredient that triggers your immune response. This can result in redness, swelling, acne, severe itching, etc. 

Here are some types of allergic reactions that can occur on your skin: 

  • Allergic contact dermatitis 
  • Irritant contact dermatitis 
  • Angular cheilitis 
  • Periorificial dermatitis 

Skincare ingredients detrimental to your skin 

There are some skincare ingredients that can cause allergic reactions and result in itching, redness, etc. Here are the ingredients or the enemies of your skin, defined below: 

  1. Fragrance: These are considered synthetic or natural compounds that offer a beautiful smell to the products. Fragrances are present in almost every cosmetic or skincare product. No wonder fragrances can cause skin allergies. Many skincare companies use unique fragrances in their products so that the customer can be lured, while they can hide the other ingredient list. However, using fragrance-free skincare products can be safe for your skin.
  2. PPD: Most of your hair dyes or other related products have PPD in it. You can even find them in dark-toned skincare products or cosmetics. They can cause skin allergies due to various reasons or sensitive skin. 
  3. Parabens: Parabens are considered to be preservatives in skincare products. They are effective in avoiding any bacterial growth. No wonder it is a great thing for the products. However, for people with sensitive skin, they can have extreme allergic reactions, and sometimes it can be irreversible. 
  4. Nickel: Not many people know, but nickel is a kind of metal that is mainly found in makeup products. The eye shadows or other cosmetic products which offer a glimmer are known to have nickel in them. No doubt it can lead to severe skin problems, especially in the sensitive areas such as the eyelids. 
  5. Formaldehyde-releasing agents: These are also a kind of preservatives that help in avoiding microbial growth. However, with time, they release formaldehyde in very tiny amounts. People with sensitive skin or any other skin issues can get allergic contact dermatitis because of this ingredient’s presence. 
  6. Oxybenzone: The sunscreens that are considered safe for everyone’s use and protect your skin from harmful UV rays might not be right for you. The one ingredient involved in most chemical sunscreens is oxybenzone, also known as benzone. It can cause allergic reactions and can be detrimental to sensitive skin. 
  7. Lanolin: Most people do not know, but lanolin is considered to be a natural wax. It is mainly derived from the wool of a sheep and is used in ointments or lip balms. However, the constant use of it can lead to severe allergic reactions, especially to people who have sensitive or inflamed lips. 
  8. Propolis: Propolis is a waxy substance that is mostly created by bees. It is known to be collected from plants as well as buds. You can find propolis in cosmetic products like lip balms or creams. People with skin issues or sensitive skin can face allergic reactions due to this ingredient. 
  9. Methylisothiazolinone: The common ingredient that is found in most cosmetic products, shampoos, liquid products, or even wet wipes is methylisothiazolinone. It is also termed MIT, which can be harmful to the skin of most people. 
  10. Aluminum: Antiperspirants are known to have one harmful ingredient, which is aluminum. It can cause your armpits to become red, peeling, and extremely discomfort due to an allergic reaction. It is essential to take care of this ingredient if you do not wish for armpit uneasiness. 

What to do after facing an allergic skin reaction? 

  • Immediately stop its use: Try to stop the use of cosmetic products that cause you an allergic reaction. This involves your hair dye, lip balms, skincare products, etc. 
  • Create a new routine: It is better to indulge in gentle skincare products. Ensure that you are using fragrance-free products as well as hypoallergenic. They are suitable for people with sensitive skin.
  • Ditch any irritants: Try not to use any harsh cleaners. Instead, you can use cool or slightly warm water to clean your face. However, try not to use any hot water, otherwise the irritation can get worse. 
  • Try to soothe the skin: It is essential to keep your skin cool. Try using a cold compress, which can be beneficial in soothing the skin. Plus, it can be effective in minimising inflammation if there is any extreme itching or swelling. 
  • Avoid skin scratching: Temporary satisfaction can hamper your skin barrier. Scratching your skin constantly should be avoided at all costs. Otherwise, the constant scratching habit can lead to extreme skin irritation and cause more problems.
  • Opt for antihistamines: Opting for over-the-counter medicines involves antihistamines, which can turn out to be beneficial. This can help in avoiding any itching or swelling. 
  • Opt for ceramide moisturisers: If you have compromised skin, then it is essential to use fragrance-free moisturisers. Ensure that you are choosing moisturisers that have ceramides in them. They are effective in restoring the skin barrier. 
  • Seek homeopathic medicine: Medical intervention is highly necessary if your skin allergy lasts for a long time. There is also a case where you can face issues like breathing, throat swelling, or swelling of the face. In this case, getting help from the best homeopathy clinic in India becomes necessary. 

Conclusion 

Skin allergic reactions due to skincare ingredients are real and need your immediate attention. The above-mentioned guide will help you seek the right information about the ingredients that can cause your skin allergies. Also, the steps necessary to be taken while facing skin allergens are listed above. Ensure that you are well aware of them and are taking the assistance of the right homeopathy doctor at the right time. This way, you can protect yourself from lifelong regret.

blogPosts.title: 7 Common Myths About Mental Health Issues
blogPosts.excerpt: Explore 7 common mental health misconceptions and why understanding the truth is vital for everyone.
blogPosts.content:
In our current day and age, discussions around mental health have seen a rise. There has been an honest attempt made to enhance the chance of making sure that each and every individual is able to seek out treatment in an essential manner. Every single day, mental health experts try to make certain that they are able to eradicate the taboo surrounding mental health disorders as well as the possibility of seeking treatment for the issues you face in an essential manner. With the help of any psychiatrist in India, you can easily make sure that you are able to enhance the possibility and likelihood of getting diagnosed, seeking treatment, and ensuring that you can thoroughly and effectively lead your life as normally as possible. 

However, reality is far from the ideal. There are still several people who thoroughly believe that having a mental health issue can make the person less than in an essential manner. There are still several people who harbour unhealthy misconceptions about mental health issues, which can lead to harmful consequences in the long run. 

In this article, we want to dispel the common misconceptions that can thoroughly and actively make sure that one is unable to seek treatment in an effective manner. The following are some of the most common myths that can prove to be harmful in the long run. 

Myth #1: Mental health showcases weaknesses 

Fact #1:

One might live under the assumption that people who develop a mental health disorder are thoroughly weak. However, this is not the case at all. Mental health issues are extensively known to be clinical disorders. Believing that mental health showcases weakness is like believing that one is weak for being physically injured.  

Myth #2: People with mental health issues are dangerous 

Fact #2:

There is also the assumption that people who have mental health issues are thoroughly dangerous. One needs to avoid them. If one believes in this myth, one might accidentally alienate their friends, family, and loved ones. If you believe in this myth, you might also end up isolating yourself as a direct result of this issue. People are sick, but they are not dangerous. They need medical help, not to be left alone and labelled as hazardous. 

Myth #3: Mental health conditions are rare 

Fact #3:

If you believe that mental health conditions are rare, you might overlook your near and dear ones who are in need of help. It is important to remember that mental health issues exist on a spectrum in an essential manner. Therefore, there are varying levels of intensity as far as mental health disorders are concerned. One might believe that people on the extreme end of the spectrum are the sole people who suffer from mental health issues in an essential manner. 

Myth #4: Therapy is only reserved for severely ill people 

Fact #4:

One might be under the assumption that therapy is only reserved for severely ill people. This is not the case at all. Anyone can seek a therapy session with a trained professional in a thorough and effective manner. One might also want to make sure that they are able to assess their emotions and properly regulate them in a comprehensive and effective manner. With the help of therapy, you can make certain that you are able to gain and garner methods of making sure that you can regulate your emotions.

Myth #5: You can only seek help in the form of medication

Fact #5:

One might also believe that mental health issues can only be treated with medications. However, one needs to make sure that they are also able to undergo different types of therapies to aid one’s progress back to an everyday life in an essential manner. 

Myth #6: Mental health conditions cannot be treated 

Fact #6:

One might also believe that mental health conditions cannot be treated. Therefore, one does not seek the treatment at all. One might want to ensure that they are able to thoroughly and actively get a diagnosis and undergo treatment for the same in an effective way. Even if you have OCD, you can seek OCD treatment in India to manage the symptoms without any worries. 

Myth #7: Bad parenting can lead to mental health issues 

Fact #7:

This myth is harmful to have as a prospective parent, a newly made one, and as an old parent. Having this misconception leads to nothing but anxiety and guilt around parenting, which can hinder you from properly doing your job in an effective manner.  

Conclusion 

In order to thoroughly make sure that you are able to seek treatment when it comes to mental health disorders, one needs to ensure that they do not harbour any misconceptions about mental health issues. Having misconceptions about mental health is extremely common in this day and age. One needs to make sure that you are able to thoroughly and actively make sure that you can dispel them in an essential manner. By reading the aforementioned points, you can easily enhance your chances of understanding the reality and completely dispelling the myths that surround issues of mental health trouble.

blogPosts.title: क्यों बार बार पानी से आँखें धोना फायदेमंद नहीं है? डॉक्टर से जानें आँखों से जुड़ी इन 5 मिथकों की सच्चाई
blogPosts.excerpt: आँखों को बार-बार धोना फायदेमंद नहीं! जानिए क्यों, और आँखों की देखभाल से जुड़ी 5 आम गलतफहमियों का सच।
blogPosts.content:
दरअसल, आंख हमारे शरीर का एक अनमोल अंग हैं। जिस से हम किसी भी सुंदर वस्तु को देख सकते हैं। हमको आपकी आँखों की हमेशा देखभाल करनी चाहिए, क्योंकि इसके बिना कोई भी व्यक्ति एक बेहतर जीवन जीने की कल्पना भी नहीं कर सकता है। अच्छा जीवन जीने के लिए अपनी आंखों को हेल्दी रखना बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी होता है। आपको बता दें कि कमजोर आँखों की वजह से ज्यादातर लोगों की आँखों पर चश्मा लगवाना पड़ता है। दरअसल आज के समय में कई लोगों को मोतियाबिंद की समस्या या फिर आंखों से जुड़ी और समस्याएं काफी ज्यादा आम हो गई है। पर कई लोग अपनी आँखों को सेहतमंद रखने के लिए कई तरह की सलाह देते हैं। पर कई मामलों में उन बातों को अपनाना आपकी आँखों के लिए हानिकारक भी हो सकता है। तो आइये इस लेख के माध्यम से इसके बारे में इस के डॉक्टर से विस्तार से जानते हैं, कि आखिर आंखों के स्वास्थ्य से जुड़े मिथक और सच्चाई क्या है?

आंखों से जुड़े मिथक और उनकी सच्चाई 

मिथक 1. अपनी आँखों को साफ रखने के लिए बार-बार पानी से धोना बेहतर होता है।

सच्चाई : दरअसल अपनी आँखों को साफ़ रखने के लिए बार बार पानी से धोना बिलकुल भी सही नहीं होता है। आमतौर पर इसकी वजह से आपकी आंखों में सूखापन, एलर्जी और इंफेक्शन जैसी संसाएयों की सम्भावना बढ़ सकती है। आपको बता दें की आप सिर्फ दिन में एक बार अपनी आंखों को पानी से धो सकते हैं, लेकिन सिर्फ और सिर्फ साफ और ठंडे पानी से।

मिथक 2 . हम अपनी आँखों पर कॉन्टैक्ट लेंस लगाकर सो सकते हैं।

सच्चाई : आमतौर पर अपनी आँखों पर कॉन्टैक्ट लेंस लगाकर सोना, दरअसल आपकी आँखों लिए बिलकुल भी सुरक्षित नहीं होता है। इसलिए आपको अपनी आँखों पर कॉन्टैक्ट लेंस पहनकर कभी भी सोना नहीं चाहिए, यहां तक कि 5 मिनट तक के लिए भी नहीं। वास्तव में इसकी वजह से आपकी आंखों को चोट लग सकती है और आपको अंधेपन की समस्या भी हो सकती है। 

मिथक 3. चश्मा पहनने से आप उन पर ही निर्भर हो जाते हैं।

सच्चाई : दरअसल कई लोगों का मानना है, कि एक बार अपनी आँखों पर चस्मा लगने के बाद आपको इस को पहनने की आदत हो जाती है और इसके बाद चस्मा नहीं उतरता है। बता दें कि ऐसा बिलकुल भी नहीं है, चश्मा पहनने से इसकी आदत नहीं बनती या फिर आपकी आंखों की शक्ति कमजोर नहीं होती है। हालाँकि चस्मा आपको बिलकुल साफ देखने में आपकी मदद करता है और इसके बिना आपको धुंधला नज़र आ सकता है। आमतौर पर मौजूदा आंख के नंबर की वजह से आपको इस की आदत नहीं लगती है। 

मिथक 4. आई ड्रॉप की मदद से मोतियाबिंद को ठीक किया जा सकता है।

सच्चाई : दरअसल यह सिर्फ एक मिथक है, की आई ड्रॉप का इस्तेमाल करके मोतियाबिंद जैसी गंभीर आंखों की समस्या को ठीक किया जा सकता है। आपकी जानकारी के लिए आपको बता दें कि ऐसा कोई भी आई ड्रॉप नहीं है, जो मोतियाबिंद जैसी गंभीर समस्या को ठीक कर सके। आमतौर पर केवल सर्जरी ही इसका एकमात्र प्रभावी इलाज होता है। दरअसल सर्जरी के दौरान आपकी आखों के अंदर के लेंस को बदल दिया जाता है, तन की आपको अपनी आँखों से बिलकुल साफ़ दिखाई दे सके।

मिथक 5.- मोतियाबिंद का ऑपरेशन तभी किया जाना चाहिए जब यह पूरी तरह से बढ़ जाए।

सच्चाई : बता दें कि यह एक पुरानी मान्यता है कि मोतियाबिंद का ऑपरेशन हमको तभी करवाना चाहिए जब ये पूरी तरह से बढ़ जाए। पर आमतौर पर आज के समय में कई तरीकों का इस्तेमाल करके आंखों की सर्जरी करके इसके शुरुआती दौर में ही मोतियाबिंद की समस्या को खत्म किया जा सकता है। असल में समय पर मोतियाबिंद की सर्जरी करने से व्यक्ति की  आँखों को बेहतर रिकवरी और बेहतर रिजल्ट मिलता है।

निष्कर्ष

आँखें हमारे शरीर का सबसे अहम हिस्सा होती हैं, जिसकी वजह से हम दुनिया के हर सुंदर से सुंदर दृश्य को देख सकते हैं। इस वजह से इसकी सही तरीके से देखभाल बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी होता है। क्या रोज पानी से आंखें धोना ठीक है या क्या कॉन्टैक्ट लेंस लगाकर सो सकते हैं? इस तरह के सवालों को लेकर कई तरह के मिथक लोगों में फैला हुआ है। हमारी आँखों का स्वस्थ रहना बहुत जरूरी होता है, इसलिए आंखों के स्वास्थ्य से जुड़ी किसी भी बात पर भरोसा करने से पहले आई स्पेशलिस्ट से सलाह करें और इसके साथ ही समय पर इसका सही इलाज पाने की कोशिश करें। अगर आपको भी इसके बारे में जानकारी प्राप्त करनी है, कि किन बातों को अपनाना आँखों के लिए हानिकारक हो सकता है और अगर आपको भी आँखों से संबंधित कोई भी समस्या है और आप इस समस्या से काफी ज्यादा परेशान हैं और आप इसका इलाज ढूंढ रहे हैं, तो आप आज ही क्लिनिक बाय चॉइस में जाकर अपनी अपॉइंटमेंट को बुक करवा सकते हैं और इसके विशेषज्ञों से इसके इलाज के बारे में जानकारी ले सकते हैं।

blogPosts.title: Hair Loss During Pregnancy: Understanding Everything About It
blogPosts.excerpt: Experiencing hair loss in pregnancy? Learn main reason behind hair loss during pregnancy and what can be done to control pregnancy hair fall
blogPosts.content:
There are instances where most women discuss their horrifying experience of extreme hair loss during pregnancy. It can be disheartening to lose lustrous as well as shiny hair when you are experiencing the most beautiful period of your life. There are many other hair issues that can be faced by pregnant women, such as dandruff, scalp issues, etc. All these problems during your pregnancy can be concerning as they are not considered normal. No wonder the issues can occur due to various reasons. It is always better to consult the best gynaecologist in Punjab to handle these issues while doing your bit in having beautiful hair. This article will guide you in understanding the reasons behind extreme hair fall during pregnancy and some tips to overcome it. 

Pregnancy: The changes in your hair 

The hormonal surge and triggered oestrogen hormone can lead to enhanced hair growth. This situation occurs mostly during the first trimester. It happens mainly because there is a pause in the growth of the hair cycle as it gets to the resting phase. Whereas, there are some women who witness sudden as well as rapid hair loss during their entire pregnancy phase. The entire situation of hair fall in pregnancy is called telogen effluvium. This situation mostly occurs during the initial five months when a woman is pregnant. It can occur in around 40-50% of women. However, the condition is mostly temporary and one need not feel depressed about it. 

The main reason behind hair loss during pregnancy

There are many factors that contribute to the situation of hair loss during pregnancy. This can be slightly concerning and it is necessary to look after the main reasons behind it: 

  • Lack of nutrition: It is always suggested that pregnant women have a nutritious diet. This is highly important for the body to meet all the demands involving essential vitamins, proteins, omega-3, and other minerals. Otherwise, the body will be able to see a severe impact due to a lack of nutrition. It is also essential to understand that extreme morning sickness can allow a woman to lose ample amounts of nutrients from her body. This further leads to extreme hairfall during the time of pregnancy.
  • Health problems: There are various health problems that can result in hair loss during pregnancy. Hair loss or shedding is not just because of a lack of nutrition, but also health issues, such as: 
  • Thyroid issues - Facing too much or too little thyroid problems can be hard to understand during the pregnancy time. Hypothyroidism, which is a lack of thyroid hormone, can affect a very small number of women but leads to constipation, muscle cramps, and other common problems. Whereas, postpartum thyroiditis can be experienced after the baby is born. 
  • Iron deficiency - This health issue can be faced because of limited red blood cells, which are responsible for supplying oxygen to the body tissues. Further, it can result in a thinning, uneven heartbeat, headache, and much more. Pregnant women are mostly at risk of getting iron deficiency anemia, especially during multiple pregnancies and morning sickness. 
  • Hormonal changes: There are women who face hair shredding and even thinning during their pregnancy period, which can be caused by sudden shock or stress. The initial or first trimester can be stressful for the body as it is adjusting to the sudden shift in hormones and supporting the growing baby. This phase or stressful period can put more than 30% of the hair in the resting phase. Also, there are chances that a woman can face around 300 or more hair strands in a day after getting pregnant. The hair loss might not be seen instantly, but the hair thinning can be noticeable after 2-4 months. No wonder this situation does not last long and can be gotten over after 6 months. 
  • Lack of vitamin B12: According to some research, vitamin B12 can slow down the hair cycle transition, the anagen phase changes to the catagen phase. When a woman is in the anagen phase, the hair remains well-maintained, but due to the decrease in vitamin B12, the body gets into the catagen phase, which results in hair shedding. 
  • Genes: It is seen that pregnant women can experience hair loss even due to their genes. If the mother of the pregnant woman had faced hair loss problems during her own pregnancy, then there is a possibility that similar experiences can occur. This is all because of genes. 
  • Reproductive problems: In some cases, women can even face hair loss issues during pregnancy due to a reaction to stopping birth control pills or any other methods of birth control. The situation of stillbirth, abortions, etc., can even lead to hair loss issues. 
  • Lack of folic acid intake: During the time of pregnancy, it is essential to know that folic acid might not be able to help with hair growth. But there have been instances where women have experienced hair loss because of low folic acid levels. 

What can be done to control pregnancy hair fall? 

Here are some tips that can be helpful in combating hair fall issues during pregnancy time: 

  • Timely hair wash: Cleaned hair and scalp is essential for hair growth. This is why it is mandatory to wash your hair after 3-4 days with a mild shampoo and conditioner. This will help maintain your scalp and hair. 
  • Gentle combing: The use of a wide-tooth comb can be helpful for your hair. It can be helpful in avoiding hair breakage. This is why it is essential to be gentle with your hair while combing it and using any other hair care tool. 
  • Hair massages: Doing hair massages with hot or mildly warm oil a few times a week can be beneficial for your hair's health. Also, it will help with hair strengthening and will avoid breakage. This tip is helpful in improving scalp blood circulation. 
  • Getting the hair trimmed: The changes in the hormones can lead to textural hair changes while a woman is pregnant. This is why it is essential to trim your hair from time to time, which can help in avoiding any hair breakage or split ends. 
  • No more stress: Stress can make everything worse. It is imperative that you work on your stress levels if you wish to manage your hair loss condition. Indulge in stress management activities or exercises.
  • Following a healthy diet: A healthy diet plays a huge role in avoiding hair fall during your time of pregnancy. This is why it is essential to maintain a balanced meal that is full of essential vitamins and minerals. Try having leafy vegetables, lentils, eggs, whole grains, etc. in your meals. 
  • No harsh hair products or color: The hair colors or hair products have certain chemicals in them that can cause allergic reactions on the scalp. It is better to avoid using harsh hair products or anything that is bad for your hair during pregnancy. 

Conclusion 

Hair loss can happen to anyone during pregnancy. Working to control it and managing the hair fall is necessary for every pregnant woman. Ensure that you are aware of its reasons and then take precautionary steps with the help of the best gynae in Ludhiana. The above-defined points will help you be aware of why it happens and the right things to do in preventing hair loss during your pregnancy.

blogPosts.title: Everything You Need To Know About Root Canal Treatment
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn all about root canal treatment—from signs you need it to the full procedure. Trusted dental info in one easy-to-read guide.
blogPosts.content:
There are many sayings that pulp plays a crucial role in keeping your tooth healthy. But have you ever wondered what the consequences would be if the pulp gets affected? Damaged pulp can negatively impact your tooth, which will lead to an interruption in your daily life activities, making it difficult to even eat properly. This is where root canal treatment comes into use. There are many dental clinics providing root canal treatment in Ludhiana with the help of experienced dentists. This article will allow you to look into the symptoms that require root canal treatment and what the procedure is. 

Four Signs That You Need A Root Canal Treatment

There are many problems that cause damage to teeth, and in the end, we are left with the option of root canal treatment. Let’s discuss the problems addressed by this treatment.

  • Pain while eating: You experience a sharp pain in your tooth, especially when you are eating or chewing food. This might be because of some infection that can slowly spread the pain in your jaw and face. Usually, this pain goes away after some days, but if it persists for a long time, then you should visit the dental clinic urgently.
  • Sensitive teeth: Sensitivity in teeth can be identified when there’s a dull pain while consuming hot and cold drinks such as ice water or hot tea. This happens when an internal nerve of the tooth is damaged. This is a matter of concern if the pain remains for several days. Therefore, you should visit the dentist.
  • An infection or swelling: When the gums are swollen around the tooth, it may be a sign of infection inside the gums. This can cause severe pain, especially when you touch it and even discolour your tooth, and make it look dark. This issue can’t be ignored, hence it needs medical attention as early as possible.
  • A cracked tooth: If your tooth is broken accidentally while chewing something very hard, then it will evade bacteria in your gums, hence causing inflammation. So it becomes necessary to go for root canal treatment to prevent any further complications.

What Is The Procedure Of Root Canal Treatment?

The process of RCT is not very complex or painful. This is done by trained dentists without causing any discomfort. The steps involved during this process are discussed below: 

  • The damaged or infected tooth is numbed by giving anaesthesia to prevent any pain during the process. 
  • Then the area is cleaned and dried with cotton. Sometimes a dental dam is used for it.
  • As the pulp is infected, in order to reach the pulp, they make a small hole in the tooth’s crown.
  • Then they remove the infected pulp by using tiny tools and place it on a thin plate. 
  • After removing the infected part, they clean the area around the tooth to ensure that no germs or bacteria are left.
  • Then it is filled with a temporary filling to seal the area.
  • After a few days, a permanent tooth cap is fixed so that you can chew properly. This gap is taken for the observation of any pain after the filling process. 

Conclusion

In case of mild pain and discomfort, you should visit a dentist to stay protected from any infection. The above-mentioned points will guide you to know when you need a root canal treatment. This will help you get rid of the regular pain and prevent your tooth from getting infected. The major benefit of root canal treatment is that it preserves your natural tooth without destroying it; therefore, you don’t have to stress about losing your teeth. Also, the root canal treatment cost in Ludhiana is budget-friendly and affordable. So there is nothing to worry about the cost as well.

blogPosts.title: Six Major Problems That Require The Attention Of A Cardiologist
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover six serious heart conditions that require expert care from a cardiologist. Learn the warning signs and when to seek medical help for heart health.
blogPosts.content:
The heart is the only organ that plays a keen role in the functioning of the overall body by supplying blood and oxygen to the other body parts. But now there is a rapid increase in the number of heart problems. There are many factors that can affect the functioning of your heart. Therefore, it is very important to take the help of cardiologists in order to cure heart diseases. A lot of heart hospitals in India have an experienced cardiologist, providing the best care that your heart actually deserves. This article will allow you to know about heart problems and how a cardiologist can help you address these issues. 

What Are The Common Heart Problems Faced By People?

There are many reasons for heart failure. This can be due to a poor lifestyle. The heart problems are discussed below:

  • Hypertension: This is the second name for high blood pressure and can happen due to the consumption of unhealthy food. Being physically inactive can also raise blood pressure in your arteries, hence causing a stroke or heart attack. Usually, it has no symptoms, so doctors call it “a silent killer.” A cardiologist can prescribe medication and suggest some exercises to prevent this.
  • Cardiac Arrest: Due to a heart attack or intake of drugs, your heart suddenly stops pumping blood, which is a sign that your heart has stopped working. This can happen suddenly and can be treated by giving CPR. Therefore, it is necessary to take the help of a cardiologist to prevent a sudden cardiac arrest. They will control the symptoms by prescribing medication. 
  • Arrythmia: Usually, your heart beats at a normal pace, but when it starts beating too fast even when you are not doing any physical activity, then it can be because of arrhythmia. Any medications or high blood pressure can be the reason for this. If you feel weakness with a fast heartbeat, then it is a warning sign for you. You must visit a cardiologist in order to get ahead of this issue. 
  • Angina: In this, you feel a sharp pain in your chest. This is because your heart doesn't receive enough blood. Your chest feels tight and heavy. This problem should not be ignored, as it can go from mild to severe and can also result in a heart attack. Therefore, it requires immediate medical attention. 
  • Endocarditis: This happens when the infection spreads to the heart. Fever and heart murmur are its signs, hinting towards a major health disease. This can’t get better on its own; therefore, it needs treatment. Many cardiologists prescribe some antibiotics to reduce the inflammation, and in some cases, the surgery is done. 
  • Cardiogenic Shock: This is a serious condition in which your heart becomes unable to pump blood to regulate the functioning of your body. This can even lead to heart failure. Usually, low blood pressure is the reason behind this. Cardiologists undergo various tests and treatments in order to save your life. 

How Do Cardiologists Manage And Treat Heart Diseases?

Cardiologists are considered the friends of your heart. This is because they deal with the issues affecting your heart and give you the proper medications.

  • At your first visit, the cardiologist listens to your symptoms and recommends some tests to identify the real problem.

blogPosts.title: Understand the Determinants Of Male Pattern Baldness
blogPosts.excerpt: Explore the genetic, hormonal, and lifestyle factors that contribute to male pattern baldness. Learn what causes hair loss and how to manage it effectively.
blogPosts.content:
Statistically, men tend to experience more baldness compared to women, primarily due to higher levels of androgens and genetic factors. Genetics is known to play a significant role in accelerating the balding process in men. However, there are also other determinants like stress and diet, which can also contribute to the baldness pattern. Fortunately for men, there are treatments and medications that help to restore their hair health. Some of the treatments recommended by specialists of hair transplant in Punjab include hair transplant and medications like minoxidil. 

What Is Male Pattern Baldness? 

Male pattern baldness is a hair loss condition that is experienced by men, which is characterised by thinning of the hair at the crown and receding of the hairline. Sometimes the condition may cause complete baldness in those areas. Further, androgenic hormones influence the condition in men by causing the hair follicles to shrink and eventually stopping the production of hair. The progression of male pattern baldness typically begins after puberty, with early stages involving subtle hair recession and thinning at the crown. When the condition advances, it causes significant hair loss at the top of the head. Treatment for this condition will require a hair transplant and some medications.

Determinants of Male Pattern Baldness  

According to specialists of hair transplant in Ludhiana, there are several factors that lead to the development of male pattern baldness, and these include the following:

  • Genetics - Hereditary factors play a big role in male pattern baldness, as it can be passed down either from the mother or the father. Furthermore, specific genes and their expressions determine the likelihood and criterion of baldness. 
  • Hormones - According to the specialists on hair treatment in Vizag, fluctuations in hormone levels can contribute to hair loss in men. The DTH hormone is also responsible for the shrinkage of hair follicles, which causes the production of new hair to stop.
  • Environmental factors - Certain environmental factors, such as stress, both physical and mental, can contribute to the development of male pattern baldness and potentially worsen the condition over time. Besides that, nutritional deficiency can also cause hair loss, especially of iron and vitamins, as they are essential nutrients.
  • Other factors - Some of the common determinants include age, as male pattern baldness is more prevalent among aged males. Additionally, medications such as chemotherapy can also cause baldness as an aftermath of the treatment. Other medical conditions like autoimmune diseases can also contribute to hair loss. 

Conclusion

From the aforementioned, it can be concluded that male pattern baldness is a condition that is determined by several factors at play, which include genetics, hormones, and environmental factors. Some habits, like smoking, have been linked with the development and progression of male pattern baldness among men. Moreover, men are encouraged to seek medical attention for their hair loss as a specialist in hair transplant in Ludhiana can provide an appropriate diagnosis and treatment for male pattern baldness. Hair health can also be improved by adopting a healthy lifestyle and diet.

What Is A Gynecological Exam

A gynecological exam is a routine evaluation of a woman's reproductive health. During this exam, the doctors usually ask about one's medical history, such as sexual history, pregnancies, menstrual cycle, and so forth. Additionally, a breast examination is also performed to check for lumps and any anomalies in the breasts. Furthermore, the gynecologist will also inspect the intimate parts for infections and other abnormalities. In some cases, an ultrasound may be required to get a clear picture of the internal organs. Thai is an opportunity for most women to discuss their reproductive health and well-being.

The Importance Of Gynecological Exams

According to the best Gynecologists in Punjab, a gynecological exam is crucial for the following reasons:

  • Early detection and prevention - There are several diseases that can be identified and prevented with the help of gynecological exams. The PEP smears can help to detect cancerous changes and allow for timely treatment. Not only that, but breast examination may help to identify lumps or other abnormalities that may be related to breast cancer. Moreover, gynecological exams help with the treatment and prevention of sexually transmitted infections. Other reproductive health issues can also be detected, like fibroids, ovarian cysts, and so on.
  • Addressing Specific Concerns - Gynecological exams help to monitor reproductive health, which includes menstruation, fertility, and birth control. According to a specialist Gynae in Ludhiana, these exams also help with menopause management and pregnancy monitoring. Gynecological exams involve pelvic exams, which help to address pelvic pains and other unusual symptoms like unusual vaginal bleeding and discharge.
  • Overall health and well-being - Regular gynecological exams provide women with reassurance about their reproductive health, which will result in peace of mind. These exams also help women to make knowledgeable decisions with regard to their sexual health, treatments, and overall health. Moreover, through these exams, women become more aware of their sexual and reproductive health as they are able to openly ask questions regarding their bodies in the exam.

Conclusion

Regular gynaecological exams are a very crucial part of preventative healthcare for women. They also offer opportunities for early diagnosis and treatment of several health issues like breast cancer, ovarian cysts, STIs, and many others. Gynaecological exams help to manage conditions that can impact women's overall well-being and quality of life. It is therefore imperative that every woman establishes a routine checkup with the best Gynecologists in Punjab to ensure their health.

दरअसल कई महिलाएं समय से पहले गर्भधारण करने से अपना बचाव करने के लिए गर्भनिरोधक गोलियों को लेती हैं। हालांकि आपको बता दें कि गर्भ निरोधक गोलियां लेने के कई और फायदे भी होते हैं, जैसे कि मासिक धर्म चक्र को नियमित करते हैं, होने वाली हैवी ब्लीडिंग को कम करते हैं, पीरियड्स के समय होने वाले दर्द से छुटकारा दिलाते हैं, और इसके साथ ही कई तरह के कैंसर के खतरे को भी कम करने में मदद करते हैं। आपको बता दें कि एक यही वजह है, कि ज्यादातर महिलाएं कंडोम का इस्तेमाल करने की बजाए गर्भ निरोधक गोलियों को लेना ज्यादा पसंद करती हैं। आमतौर पर कंसीव करने से अपना बचाव करने के लिए महिलाओं को गर्भ निरोधक गोलियों को नियमित रूप से लेना पड़ता है। बता दें कि यहां पर एक सवाल जो महिलाओं को काफी ज्यादा परेशान करता है, की गर्भ निरोधक गोलियों को लेने के कितने समय बाद सेक्स किया जाना सुरक्षित होता है? तो आइये इस लेख के माध्यम से इसके डॉक्टर से इसके बारे में विस्तार से जानकारी प्राप्त करते हैं। 

गर्भ निरोधक गोलियां लेने के कितनी देर बाद संभोग किया जाना सुरक्षित होता है?

इस पर डॉक्टर का कहना है, कि गर्भधारण से बचने के लिए महिलाओं को किसी भी तरह कि गर्भ निरोधक गोलियों को लगातार 7 दिनों तक लेना पड़ता है। बता दें कि अगर आप अपने मासिक धर्म के शुरुआती पहले पांच दिनों के भीतर ही इस गोली को लेना शुरू कर देते हैं, तो समय से पहले गर्भधारण से जल्दी बचा जा सकता है। डॉक्टर के अनुसार, इस जानकारी को प्राप्त करने के बावजूद हर महिला को गर्भ निरोधक गोलियों को नियमित रूप से लेने से पहले एक बार अपने डॉक्टर या फिर गायनोकॉलोजिस्ट से जरूर इसके बारे में सलाह करनी चाहिए। क्योंकि डॉक्टरों का मानना है, कि किसी भी तरह की दवा की शुरुआत करने से पहले ज्यादा जरूरी है, कि महिला की मेडिकल कंडीशन के बारे में सभी जरूरी जानकारी उसके डॉक्टर को पता हो। दरअसल इसके बाद ही यह फैसला किया जा सकता है, कि महिलाओं को गर्भ निरोधक गोलियां लेने के कितने समय बाद यौन संबंध बनाना चाहिए।

गर्भ निरोधक गोलियों का महिला की सेक्सुअल लाइफ पर क्या असर पड़ता है? 

बता दें कि गर्भ निरोधक गोलियां आमतौर पर महिलाओं की सेक्सुअल लाइफ को कई तरीकों से प्रभावित कर सकता है। आइये इस के माध्यम से इसके बारे में विस्तार से जानते हैं, 

1. लिबिडो में कमी

आपको बता दें कि गर्भ निरोधक गोलियां लेने की वजह से कुछ महिलाओं में यौन इच्छा की कमी हो जाती है। आमतौर पर ऐसा इसलिए होता है, क्योंकि गर्भ निरोधक गोलियां का सेवन करने की वजह से ज्यादातर महिलाओं के शरीर में हार्मोनल बदलाव होते हैं, जिसकी वजह से उनके लिबिडो के स्तर में कमी आ जाती है। 

2. वजाइनल ड्राइनेस

आमतौर पर नेशनल इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ हेल्थ के अनुसार गर्भ निरोधक गोलियों को लेने की वजह से महिलाओं में वजाइनल ड्राइनेस यानि की योनि में सूखापन की समस्या हो जाती है। इस तरह की स्थिति में उन महिलाओं के लिए यौन संबंध बनाना काफी ज्यादा दर्द भरा हो जाता है। दरअसल हमने पहले भी इसका जिक्र किया है कि महिलाओं में हार्मोनल बदलाव की वजह से एस्ट्रोजन का स्तर बहुत कम हो जाता है। इस लिए उनको वजाइनल ड्राइनेस (योनि में सूखापन) की परेशानी का सामना करना पड़ता है। 

3. हार्मोनल साइड इफेक्ट्स 

आपको बता दें कि गर्भ निरोधक गोलियां लेने की वजह से कई महिअलों में मूड स्विंग, चिड़चिड़ापन या डिप्रेशन जैसी समस्याएं हो जाती हैं, जो यौन जीवन को काफी ज्यादा प्रभावित कर सकती हैं।

4. वजन बढ़ना और शारीरिक बदलाव 

दरअसल इन गोलिओं के सेवन से महिलाओं के आत्मविश्वास पर काफी ज्यादा प्रभाव पड़ता है, जो अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से यौन जीवन को प्रभावित करता है। 

5. हार्मोन पर निर्भरता 

आपको बता दें कि महिला के शरीर को गोली के अनुकूल होने में काफी समय लगता है। इसलिए शुरुआत में महिलाओं का यौन जीवन प्रभावित हो सकता है। 

निष्कर्ष

कई महिलाएं समय से पहले गर्भधारण करने से बचने के लिए गर्भ निरोधक गोलियां लेती हैं। हर महिला पर गर्भ निरोधक गोलियों का असर अलग-अलग होता है। यह गोलियां कुछ महिलाओं के यौन जीवन को आसान और सुखद बना देती हैं, जबकि कुछ महिलाओं को इस में असुविधा महसूस हो सकती है। इससे महिलाओं को कई तरह के लाभ मिलते हैं, जैसे कि मासिक धर्म चक्र को नियमित करना, भारी रक्तस्राव को कम करना, मासिक धर्म के दर्द से राहत और कई प्रकार के कैंसर के खतरे को कम करने में मदद करना। इसके साथ ही गर्भ निरोधक गोलियों से महिलाओं की सेक्सुअल लाइफ पर काफी असर पड़ता हैं, इसके कारण कुछ महिलाओं को यौन इच्छा की कमी, योनि में सूखापन की समस्या, हार्मोनल साइड इफेक्ट्स, वजन बढ़ना और हार्मोन के आधार पर शरीर में परिवर्तन आदि समस्याएं उत्पन्न हो जाती हैं। कुल मिलाकर, कहने की बात ये है, कि महिलाओं को डॉक्टर की सलाह पर ही गर्भ निरोधक गोलियों को लेना चाहिए। इसके साथ ही महिलाएं अपने यौन संबंध कब सामान्य तौर पर शुरू कर सकती हैं, इसके बारे में भी उनको अपने विशेषज्ञ से सलाह लेनी चाहिए। क्योंकि कई बार गलत समय पर यौन संबंध बनाने की वजह से कंसीव करने का डर बना रहता है। इसलिए गोली शुरू करने से पहले एक बार अपने डॉक्टर से सलाह लेना बहुत जरूरी है, ताकि सही विकल्प चुना जा सके। अगर आपको भी इसके बारे में ज्यादा जानकारी प्राप्त करनी है। और गर्भ निरोधक गोलियों को लेने से पहले विशेषज्ञों से इसके बारे में जानना चाहती हैं, तो आप आज ही क्लीनिक बाय चॉइस में जाकर अपनी अपॉइंटमेंट को बुक करवा सकते हैं और इसके विशेषज्ञों से इसके बारे में जानकारी प्राप्त कर सकते हैं। 

अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल 

प्रश्न 1. गर्भ निरोधक गोलियां कब काम करना शुरू करती है?

आपको बता दें कि गर्भ निरोधक गोलियां केवल 7 दिनों के अंदर  ही प्रभावी तरीके से काम करना शुरू कर देती हैं। लेकिन अगर आप गर्भ निरोधक गोलियों को लेते हैं, तो आमतौर पर यह गोलियां महज 72 घंटे के अंदर ही काम करना शुरू कर देती हैं। दरअसल गर्भावस्था को रोकने के लिए 28-दिन की गर्भनिरोधक गोली को लेना जारी रखना बहुत जरूरी होता है। आपको बता दें कि जैसे ही आप गर्भ धारण करने की योजना को बनाए, तो उस दौरान इन गोलियों को लेना बंद कर दें।

प्रश्न 2. अपनी गर्भावस्था से बचने के लिए मुझे गोली कब लेनी चाहिए?

आमतौर पर अपनी गर्भावस्था से बचने के लिए दरअसल आप कंडोम का इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं। दरअसल अगर महिलाएं यौन संबंध बनाने के लिए कंडोम का इस्तेमाल नहीं करती हैं, तो आमतौर पर वह उस वक्त गर्भ निरोधक गोलियां ले सकती हैं। आपको बता दें कि इमरजेंसी गोलियों को 72 घंटे के अंदर लेना चाहिए। 

प्रश्न 3. गर्भ न ठहरे इसके लिए क्या करना चाहिए?

आपको बता दें कि गर्भ न ठहरे इसके लिए आपको सुरक्षित यौन संबंध स्थापित करना चाहिए। इसके लिए, आमतौर पर कंडोम, गर्भ निरोधक गोलियां आदि को ले सकते हैं। दरअसल इस दौरान महिलाएं कॉपर-टी भी लगवा सकती हैं और पुरुष इस दौरान नसबंदी करवा सकते हैं।

blogPosts.title: Why Do You Need to Pay Attention to Women’s Health?
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn the importance of women’s health and how it impacts families, communities, and future generations.
blogPosts.content:
When it comes to the well-being of women, nothing is more important than the experience and the comfort that they trust. If you're searching for a qualified gynae in India, there are several things you need to consider. With the growing number of experienced specialists and the improved fundamentals, Ludhiana is now the hub for gynaecological excellence in North India.
Women's health is not just about reproductive care, it's about authorising women to live healthier, longer, and more fulfilling lives. From puberty through menopause and beyond, every stage of a woman's life brings different physical and emotional transformation.

The Importance of Women's Health

Women's bodies undergo a complex set of changes throughout their lives. Hormonal fluctuations, pregnancy, childbirth, and menopause all require informed medical support. Preventing symptoms or delaying care can lead to enduring well-being issues.

Core reasons why women's health deserves focused attention

  1. Early checkup of Reproductive Issues: Regular checkups can help identify the problems such as ovarian cysts, fibroids, endometriosis, and cervical abnormalities at an early stage.
  2. Fertility Planning: Fertility assessments and counseling are serious for women looking to conceive, mostly after age 30.
  3. Pregnancy & Postnatal Care: Safe pregnancy, delivery, and postpartum recovery need experience with obstetric support.
  4. Handling Menopause: Gynaecologists assist women in productively handling symptoms such as hot flashes and mood transformation.

The Role of a Gynae in Women's Health

A gynae is a specialist trained in diagnosing and treating issues connected to the female reproductive system. Their care extends beyond reproductive health into avoiding screenings, hormonal therapy, and even mental wellness support.

Areas Where Gynae Care Makes a Difference:

Menstrual well-being

Unsystematic periods, heavy bleeding, or severe cramps are not \"just part of being a woman.\" A gynaecologist can diagnose the cause and offer relief through medication, therapy, or minimally invasive methods.

Fertility and Pregnancy

For those facing infertility, upgraded treatments like IUI or IVF may be suggested.

Infections and STDs

Vaginal infections and sexually transmitted diseases (STDs) are ordinary but treatable. Gynae care makes sure the accurate diagnosis and safe, productive treatment.

Menopause and Aging

As women age, estrogen levels decline, and various aspects of their well being including bone density and mood. Gynaecologists help manage these changes with hormone replacement therapy, dietary advice, and regular health checkups.

Conclusion

Investing in your well-being is not too popular, it is imperative. Even when you're a teenager, a new mom, or going through menopause, expert gynaecological care ensures you're not alone in your journey. Selecting the right gynae in Ludhiana or anywhere in Punjab gives you the confidence of experienced care when it matters most.

blogPosts.title: Prepare Your Body for Fue Procedure With the Following Steps
blogPosts.excerpt: Preparing for an FUE procedure? Discover simple body prep tips to ensure safe surgery, faster healing, and natural-looking results.
blogPosts.content:
Our hair is perhaps one of the most aesthetic features we have. It shapes so much of our personality as well as our face that it becomes difficult to imagine how we will be without it. Losing one’s hair can thoroughly and extensively lead to issues with a person’s self-confidence and esteem in an extensive manner. However, it is essential to note that one can seek a hair transplant in Ludhiana to ensure the possibility of addressing and resolving the issue in an extensive and effective manner.

If you or someone you know has become conscious because of the extensive hair loss you are facing, it is essential to note that your life does not stop here. One needs to make sure that they can find a solution with the help of a hair transplant procedure in an extensive manner. In this article, we discuss one of the hair transplant methods and how one can prepare themselves to thoroughly undergo the procedure. By knowing how to prepare yourself, you can make certain that you are able to thoroughly and extensively avoid any complications when it comes to undergoing the FUE procedure.

What is the FUE Procedure?

The FUE procedure for hair transplant, also known as the follicular unit extraction, is one of the most effective solutions to the problem of hair loss. Essentially, in this procedure, the surgeon ensures that they can pick single hair follicles from your donor area and place them in your recipient area. This procedure thoroughly and extensively makes sure that the surgeon can precisely and accurately build the hairline of their patient with the best possible solution. This process allows a lot of control to the surgeon as well as the patient.

How to Prepare Yourself for the FUE Procedure?

If you have never undergone the FUE treatment procedure, you can find yourself intimidated and overwhelmed by the procedure. With the help of your hair transplant provider, you can go through the process of the FUE procedure in order to ensure that you are not caught off-guard by the procedure. In this section, you can make certain that you are able to thoroughly understand the ways in which you can prepare yourself for the FUE procedure. The following are some of the ways you can keep in mind in order to prepare yourself for the procedure:

  • Consult your surgeon: One of the ways you can make sure that you are ready for the procedure is to ask your surgeon for care advice.
  • Stop specific medications: It is also essential to make sure that if you are on a medication schedule, you can tell your surgeon about it. Let them ascertain whether you need to stop taking these medications or not.
  • Hair care methodology: If there are particular things you do to your hair, one is advised to make sure that you can avoid engaging in them and alter your hair care routine to match whatever is required of you in preparation for the procedure.
  • Avoid alcohol and smoking before the procedure: It is also extensively advised that one is able to thoroughly and efficiently avoid drinking alcohol and smoking cigarettes for a few days before the procedure so as not to cause complications for you.
  • Rest: Once the procedure is done, it is also essential to make sure that one can thoroughly and extensively rest. One needs to make sure that they can heal properly from the procedure.
  • Follow-up sessions: Furthermore, it is also essential to make sure that you are able to thoroughly and extensively attend all the follow-up sessions that your hair transplant surgeon asks you to attend. This will make certain that your recovery is monitored by healthcare professionals. If there are any issues in the recovery, they can address them effectively.

Conclusion

If you are facing the issue of permanent hair loss, it can significantly impact a person’s self-confidence and esteem. One might also suffer from problems with their body image and appearance. This issue can thoroughly foster several insecurities in a person. However, one needs to make sure that you are able to thoroughly undergo the possibility of a hair transplant in Vizag to ensure that you can extensively resolve the situation. By ensuring that you are able to undergo the FUE procedure, you can have a head full of hair and fix all your self-conscious thoughts without any worries.

blogPosts.excerpt: Understand the major factors that decide LASIK surgery costs in India and make an informed choice for safe and affordable vision correction.
blogPosts.content:
A great number of the general populace are suffering from a lot of eye issues, some of which require treatments like Lasik surgery. No doubt, surgery is very effective; however, not everyone can afford the surgery, as it can be expensive. Moreover, the cost of Lasik surgery in India can be influenced by various factors like the kind of procedure, surgeon's expertise and reputation, and so on. Fortunately, this procedure is relatively cheaper in India compared to other parts of the world, like Europe and the West. Eye vigour has to be prioritised always to avoid eye complications and vision loss.

What Is Lasik Surgery

LASIK surgery is a laser eye procedure that is used to correct eye issues such as astigmatism and hyperopia. Surgeons reshape the underlying tissue of the cornea to correct refractive errors. A lot of people prefer this treatment as it helps to eliminate the need for wearing glasses and contacts by improving vision. However, people have to understand that Lasik surgery is not for everyone; hence, they need to consult a professional eye specialist from eye hospitals in Punjab to determine whether it is the appropriate treatment for them.

Factors Influencing The Cost Of LASIK Surgery In India

Lasik surgery cost in India may vary depending on several factors, which include the following:

  • Type of procedure - There are different types of LASIK surgery, and the standard LASIK surgery is the most affordable one. Other procedures that require advanced technology, like custom, bladeless, and smile laser treatments, are on the high-end spectrum; however, the outcome of these procedures is better than standard Lasik surgery, as they offer more precision, faster healing, and visual recovery.
  • Technology and equipment - This is a major determinant of cost, as most clinics that use advanced technology and laser tools are likely to charge more compared to others. The logic behind the surge in cost due to advanced technologies and tools is that they offer precision, are much safer, and also require a high initial investment to acquire them.
  • Surgeon's expertise and reputation - Undoubtedly, seasoned surgeons are more likely to charge more due to their strong track record and experience in the field. Besides that, there are other additional costs like consultation fees, follow-up fees, and many others that have to be paid to the specialists before and after the surgery, which also contribute to the increase in cost.

Conclusion

The aforementioned are some of the factors that influence the cost of Lasik surgery in India. There are also other determinants, such as the location of the clinic, pre- and post-operative care, among many others. According to eye surgeons from several eye hospitals, the complexity of the error and other existing eye conditions influence the type of procedure one has to have and consequently the cost. Fortunately, there are a lot of eye hospitals in India that offer payment plans and other flexible payment options to make Lasik surgery possible for their patients.

blogPosts.excerpt: Choosing the right neurologist is crucial. Explore helpful advice to guide your decision with confidence.
blogPosts.content:
Finding the right doctor for your medical condition can sometimes be a hard decision. When it comes to brain or nervous system issues, a neurologist can be helpful. These medical doctors are meant to diagnose, treat, and even manage disorders related to the brain, spinal cord, etc. A neurologist is well aware of the anatomy, functions, as well as conditioning that can severely affect the nervous system as well as nerves. No wonder the nervous system is considered to be the command centre of the body, and looking after its health is highly mandatory. This article will help you understand more about a neurologist and the right way to select the best neurologist in Ludhiana.

Understanding the diseases or conditions treated by a neurologist

There are some common disorders that are treated only by a neurologist, such as:

  • Alzheimer's disease or dementia
  • Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
  • Epilepsy
  • Concussion
  • Brain injury, the injury of the spinal cord, and even vascular malformations
  • Cerebral aneurysms or arteriovenous malformations
  • Cerebral palsy or spasticity
  • Facial pain
  • Encephalitis
  • Meningitis
  • Multiple sclerosis
  • Neck pain, back, or spinal pain
  • Parkinson’s disease
  • Stroke
  • Sleep disorders
  • Brain tumor, the spinal, or nerve tumors
  • Headache or migraine, and many more issues.

What is the right way opted for by a neurologist for a diagnosis?

The neurologist is going to ask you about the previous medical history, family history, and the history of prescribed medication, along with the leading symptoms. There will also be a neurologic examination, which involves:

  • Coordination, gait, balance, etc.
  • Muscle strength
  • Mental health
  • Sensation
  • Vision, hearing, etc.

A neurologist may also suggest that you undergo blood, urine, or various tests, which can be effective in understanding the severity of the condition and keeping an eye on the medication levels. However, there can be involvement of genetic testing, which can be effective in identifying inherited disorders. Also, for the nervous system, there can be imaging studies which can help in the entire diagnosis. Neurologists are known to treat patients with the help of various medications, physical therapy, along with various other approaches.

When is the right time to make a neurologist’s appointment?

There are some common symptoms that indicate making an appointment with a neurologist:

  • Memory disturbances
  • There is a loss of consciousness
  • Seizures
  • Taste and disturbances with the smell
  • Numbness or sensation of tingling
  • Facial asymmetries
  • Muscle weakness, spasms, twitching, etc.
  • Vertigo, deafness, etc.
  • Tremors
  • Slow movements
  • Neck pain, headache, etc.
  • Burning sensation
  • Tremors, etc.

Top tips to consult a neurologist at the right time

There are some common tips which can help you find the right neurologist, such as:

  • Get proper referrals

The first thing to do is to review the references that are offered by the primary care doctor. However, if you are not in contact with any doctor, then try asking your friends, family, and various others for the right recommendations. However, it is essential to take some time and look for the credentials and the experience they hold. While narrowing down your options, book a consultation appointment with your selected neurologist and make a decision whether you want to continue with them or not.

  • Do not overlook the experience of a neurologist.

The doctor’s experience matters the most when you are having a neurological illness. The more experience a neurologist has in a particular condition, the better the chances of you getting healthy. This is why it is essential to consult neurologists who have experience and even get to know the number of patients they have treated. For example, if you are dealing with multiple sclerosis, then it is better to consult a neurologist with experience in treating this particular condition.

  • Quality of the hospital

Most people often overlook that a neurologist’s hospital is going to be your hospital. This is why it is essential to look at the hospital and what kind of facilities are being offered to the patients. Hospital quality matters the most because in such situations, patients can have fewer complications and have great survival rates. Also, try to see the hospital’s location because if the hospital is located closer, then you can reach it quickly during any mishap.

  • The style of communication and approachability

A neurologist should be approachable. Plus, you should be comfortable in having an open conversation with them. This way, you will be able to experience complete transparency in your case. No wonder neurological diseases are considered to be complicated and need extensive study of a patient's history; this is why open communication is highly required. Treating neurological diseases depends more on open discussions as compared to sophisticated scans. Due to all of this, it is imperative to look for a neurologist who is more welcoming and answers all the questions without any issue. Also, the communication needs to be two-way.

  • Credentials of a neurologist

Accreditation is the primary thing that should be considered when finding the best neurologist. The factors like credentials, training, etc., will let you know about their qualifications. Also, you will get to know the training of a doctor, skills, and overall experience. This way, you will be able to have the best neurological treatment without falling into any pitfalls or wrong information about a neurologist.

Conclusion

Not many people know, but neurologists and neurosurgeons are different. Also, their training is considered to be different. Most people who are unaware of neurology often end up meeting a neurosurgeon, and this can land you in more trouble. The above-mentioned information will help you in understanding more about a neurologist and the best ways or points to choose one. Also, if you are looking for the best brain tumor treatment in Punjab, it is essential that you find the best neurologist who can provide you with the best treatment. Follow the above-mentioned points religiously so that you do not end up making a wrong decision. Every point will take you closer to experiencing the best neurological treatment and lead a healthy life.
